a: Amar leh: "estereh ana veevneyeh". amar: "let li ducheta lemedar ba". amar leh: "ana ogar lach ducheta". amar leh: "la tarachna". "la ka mittedar li". "shuf akkeresach veul, vashuf akkeresach ufok".
Amar rav chama: bedina ka meakkev. vehane mille dela matu keshure lematta measara, aval matu keshure lematta measara, matze amar leh: lematta measara reshuta didi hu, vela meshabad lach.
Vehane mille dela atno gabbe hadade, aval atno gabbe hadade – satri uvanu.

Vechi atno bahade hadade – ad kamma? amru rabbanan kammeh derabba mishshemeh demar zutera bereh derav nachman, deamar mishshemeh derav nachman, keotah sheshshaninu: rumo – kachatzi orko vechachatzi rochbo. amar lehu rabba, lav amena lechu: la titlo beh buke serike berav nachman?! hachi amar rav nachman: ki dedayyri inashe. vechamma? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: ki hechi deayyli issureyata demachoza, vehadar.

Hahu gavra dahava bane ashita achore kavvevy dechavreh. amar leh: ka maaflat alay. amar leh: sacharna lach hacha, veavedna lach kavvevy leel meashitay. amar leh: ka marat leh laashitay. amar leh: satarna lach laashitach ad ducheta dechavvevy, uvanena la, veavedna lach kavvevy bevinyana – leel meashitay. amar leh: ashita mittattaa attika, umilleel chadta – la kayyma.

Amar leh: satarna la ad leara, uvanena la, veavedna lach kavvevy begavva. amar leh: chada ashita chadta bechulleh beta attika, la kayyma. amar leh: satarna la lechulleh beta, uvanena lach kavvevy bevinyana. amar leh: let li ducheta lemedar ba. amar leh: agayrna lach ducheta. amar leh: la tarachna. amar rav chama: bedin ka meakkev.
Hayeynu hach – veha tu lema li? ha ka mashma lan – deaf al gav dela mishtammesh ella tivna uve tzive bealma.

Hanhu be tere ache defalgi bahade hadade; chad matyeh ispelida, vechad matyeh tarbitza. azal hahu dematyeh tarbitza, veka vane ashita appumma deispelida. amar leh: ka maaflat alay. amar leh: bedidi ka vanena. amar rav chama: bedin kaamar leh.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, may shena meha detanya: shene achin shechalku, echad mehen natal sede cherem veechad mehen natal sede lavan – yesh lo levaal hakkerem arba ammot bisde lavan, sheal menat ken chalku?

Amar leh: hatam deallu lahadade. aval hacha – may, dela allu lahadade? vechi beshufetane askinan – dehay shakel ispelida vehay shakel tarbitza, vela allu lahadade?! amar leh: nehi deallu lahadade deme livne, keshure vehudere; deme avvera la allu lahadade.
Velema leh: meikkara ispelida pelagt li, hasheta meshavvet li idderona! amar rav shimi bar ashe: shema bealma pelag leh.

Mi la tanya, haomer: "bet kor afar ani mocher lach", af al pi sheeno ella letech – higgio, shello machar lo ella shema; vehu demitkere "bet kor". "pardes ani mocher lach", af al pi sheen bo rimmonim – higgio, shello machar lo ella shema; vehu demitkere "pardes". "kerem ani mocher lach", af al pi sheen bo gefanim – higgio, shello machar lo ella shema; vehu demitkere "karma"?!
Mi dame?! hatam, matze amar leh mocher lelokeach: shema zabbeni lach; hacha, matze amar leh: addata dehachi pelagi – dedaerna beh ki hechi dedaru avahatan.
Amaru leh
b: Mar yanoka umar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: nehardae letamayyhu – deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: haachin shechalku – en lahen lo derech ze al ze,
Velo challonot ze al ze, velo sullamot ze al ze, velo ammat hammayim ze al ze, vehizzaharu bahen shehalachot kevuot hen. verava amar: yesh lahen.

Hahu shetara deyatme, denafek aleh tevara. amar rav chama: agboye la magbinan leh, umikra la karinan leh. agboye la magbinan leh – dinfak tevara aleh. mikra la karinan leh – dechi gadli yatme, dilma mayytu reaya umari leh.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava leravina: hilcheta may? amar leh: bechullehu hilcheta kerav chama, levar mittevara – desahade beshakkare la machzekinan.
Mar zutera bereh derav mari amar: beha name hilcheta kerav chama; deim ita ditvara mealleya hu – ibbei leh leappoke bechayye avuhon, umiddela appekeh – shema minna zayyofe zayyeyfeh.

Mishna kofin oto livnot bet shaar vadelet lechatzer. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo kol hachatzerot reuyot levet shaar. kofin oto livnot lair choma udelatayim uveriach. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo kol haayayrot reuyot lechoma.
Kamma yehe bair vihe keanshe hair? shenem asar chodesh. kana bah bet dira – hare hu keanshe hair miyyad.
Gemara lememra devet shaar mealleyuta hi?! veha hahu chasida dahava regil eliyyahu dahava mishtae bahadeh; avad bet shaar, vetu la mishtae bahadeh! la kashya: ha miggavvay, ha mibbaray.

Vei baet ema: ha veha mibbaray, vela kashya: ha deit leh delet, ha delet leh delet. i baet ema: ha veha deit leh delet, vela kashya: ha deit leh potachat, ha delet leh potachat. i baet ema: ha veha deit leh potachat, vela kashya: ha defotachat dideh miggavvay, ha defotachat dideh mibbaray.

Kofin oto livnot bet shaar vadelet lechatzer. tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo kol chatzerot reuyot levet shaar; ella chatzer hassemucha lirshut harabbim – reuya levet shaar, vesheenah semucha lirshut harabbim – enah reuya levet shaar. verabbanan – zimnin dedachaki bene reshut harabbim, veayylu veatu.

Kofin oto livnot lair kulei. tanu rabbanan: kofin oto laasot lair delatayim uveriach. verabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo kol haayayrot reuyot lechoma; ella ir hassemucha lassefar – reuya lechoma, vesheenah semucha lassefar – enah reuya lechoma. verabbanan – zimnin demikkeru veate geyaysa.
Bea minneh rabbi elazar merabbi yochanan: keshehen govin, lefi nefashot govin, o dilma lefi shevach mamon govin? amar leh: lefi mamon govin; veelazar beni, keva bah masmerot!
Ikka deamri, bea minneh rabbi elazar merabbi yochanan: keshehen govin, lefi keruv battim hen govin, o dilma lefi mamon govin? amar leh: lefi keruv battim hen govin; veelazar beni, keva bah masmerot!

Rabbi yehuda nesia rema deshura adderabbanan. amar resh lakish: rabbanan la tzerichi netiruta, dichtiv: "esperem mechol yirbun" – esperem leman? ilema letzaddikim – dinfishi mechala; hasheta kullehu yisrael ketiv behu: "kachol asher al sefat hayyam", tzaddikim atzmam "mechol yirbun"?!

Ella hachi kaamar: esperem lemaasehem shel tzaddikim, mechol yirbun. vekal vachomer: uma chol, shemmuat – megen al hayyam; maasehem shel tzaddikim, shehem merubbim – lo kol shekken shemmeginnim alehem.
Ki ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: may tama la tema leh meha: "ani choma veshaday kammigdalot"; "ani choma" – zo tora, "veshaday kammigdalot" –

a: Ellu talmide chachamim. veresh lakish, savar la kiddaresh rava: "ani choma" – zo keneset yisrael, "veshaday kammigdalot" – ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot.
Rav nachman bar rav chisda rema keraga arabbanan. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak: avart addeorayyta veaddinvie veaddichtuve.

Addeorayyta – dichtiv: "af chovev ammim kol kedoshav beyadecha" – amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, afillu beshaa sheatta mechabbev ammim – kol kedoshav yihyu beyadecha. "vehem tukku leraglecha" – tane rav yosef: ellu talmide chachamim, shemmechattetim raglehem meir leir umimmedina limdina lilmod tora, "yissa middabberotecha" – lissa velitten bedibburotav shel makom.

Addinvie – dichtiv: "gam ki yitnu vaggoyim atta akabbetzem, vayyachellu meat mimmassa melech vesarim" – amar ulla: pasuk ze bilshon aramit neemar: "i tanu" kullehu – "atta akabbetzem", veim "meat" mehem – "yachellu mimmassa melech vesarim".
Addichtuve – dichtiv: "minda velo vahalach, la shallit lemirme alehom"; veamar rav yehuda: "minda" – zo menat hammelech, "belo" – zo kesaf guvlgalta, "vahalach" – zo arnona.

Rav pappa rema karya chadta ayyatme, amar leh rav shisha bereh derav idi lerav pappa: vedilma la middevil! amar leh: mishkal shakelna minnayyhu; i middevil – middevil, vei la – mahdarna la nihalayyhu.

Amar rav yehuda: hakkol laagalle gafa, afillu miyyatme; aval rabbanan – la tzerichi netiruta. hakkol lecharya patya, afillu merabbanan; vela amaran ella dela nafki bechaloza, aval nafki bechaloza – rabbanan lav bene mippak bechaloza ninhu.

Rabbi patach otzarot bishne vatztzoret, amar: yikkansu baale mikra, baale mishna, baale talmud, baale halacha, baale haggada; aval amme haaretz al yikkansu. dachak rabbi yonatan ben amram venichnas. amar lo: "rabbi, parneseni!" amar lo: "beni, karita?" amar lo: "lav". "shanita?" amar lo: "lav". "im ken, bamma afarnesecha?" [amar lo:] "parneseni kechelev ucheorev". parneseh.

Batar dinfak yetev rabbi veka mitztaar, veamar: oy li shennatatti pitti leam haaretz! amar lefanav rabbi shimon bar rabbi: shemma yonatan ben amram talmidcha hu, sheeno rotze lehanot mikkevod tora miyyamav? badku veashkach. amar rabbi: yikkansu hakkol.

Rabbi letameh, daamar rabbi: en pureanut ba laolam ella bishvil amme haaretz. kehahu deme chelila dishdo atteverya, ato lekammeh derabbi vaamaru leh: "littevu rabbanan bahadan". amar lehu: "la". amaru leh: "arvkinan". [amar lehu:] "aroku". araku palgehon, dalyu palga.

Ato hanhu palga kamme derabbi, amaru leh: "littevu rabbanan bahadan". amar lehu: "la". "arvkinan". "aruku". araku kullehu, pash hahu koves. shadyu akkoves. arak koves, peka kelila. amar rabbi: reitem sheen pureanut ba laolam ella bishvil amme haaretz.
Vechamma yehe bair vihe keanshe hair vechulei. ureminhi: hachammeret vehaggammelet haoveret mimmakom lemakom, velana betochah vehuddecha immahen, hen biskila, umamonan palet.
Veim nishtahu sham sheloshim yom – hen besayif, umamonan aved!

Amar rava, la kashya: ha livne mata, ha leyatove mata. kidtanya: hammuddar hanaa meanshe hair; kol shennishtaha sham shenem asar chodesh – asur lehanot mimmennu, pachot mikkan – muttar. miyyoshve hair; kol shennishtaha sham sheloshim yom – asur lehanot mimmennu, pachot mikkan – muttar lehanot mimmennu.

Ulechol mille mi bainan shenem asar chodesh? vehatanya: sheloshim yom – letamchuy, shelosha chodashim – lekuppah, shishsha – lichsut, tisha – likvura, shenem asar – lefasse hair! amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: ki tenan name matnitin "shenem asar chodesh" – lefasse hair tenan.

Veamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol lefasse hair, vaafillu miyyatme; aval rabbanan – la, derabbanan la tzerichi netiruta. amar rav pappa: leshura ulefarasha uleturzina – afillu miyyatme; aval rabbanan – la tzerichi netiruta. kelala demilleta: kol milleta deit lehu hanaa minneh – afillu miyyatme.
Rabba rema tzedaka ayyatme deve bar mariyyon. amar leh abbaye, vehatane rav shemuel bar yehuda: en poskin tzedaka al hayyetomim – afillu lefidyon shevuyim! amar leh: ana leachshovinhu ka avedna.

Ifra hormiz, immeh deshabbur malka, shaddara arneka dedinare lekammeh derav yosef, amara: leheve lemitzva rabba. yatev rav yosef veka meayyen ba, may "mitzva rabba"? amar leh abbaye: middetane rav shemuel bar yehuda: en poskin tzedaka al hayyetomim afillu lefidyon shevuyim, shema minna
b: Pidyon shevuyim mitzva rabba hi.

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan defidyon shevuyim mitzva rabba hi? amar leh, dichtiv: "vehaya ki yomru elecha ana netze, veamarta alehem ko amar Adonai, asher lammavet – lammavet, vaasher lacherev – lacherev, vaasher laraav – laraav, vaasher lashshevi – lashshevi". veamar rabbi yochanan: kol hameuchar befasuk ze kashe mechavero.
Cherev kasha mimmavet – i baet ema kera, vei baet ema sevara. i baet ema sevara – hay ka minnavvavl, vehay la ka minnavvavl. veibbaet ema kera – "yakar beene Adonai hammavta lachasidav".
Raav kashe mecherev – ibbaet ema sevara: hay ka mitztaar, vehay la ka mitztaar. ibbaet ema kera: "tovim hayu challe cherev mechalle raav". shevi [kashe mikkullam] – dechullehu itanhu beh.
Tanu rabbanan: kuppa shel tzedaka nigbet bishnayim, umitchalleket bishlosha. nigbet bishnayim – sheen osim serarot al hatztzibbur pachot mishshenayim, umitchalleket bishlosha – kedine mamonot.
Tamchuy nigbet bishlosha, umitchalleket bishlosha; sheggibbuyah vechillukah shavim. tamchuy – bechol yom, kuppa – meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.
Tamchuy – laaniyye olam, kuppa – laaniyye hair. verashshaim bene hair laasot kuppa – tamchuy, vetamchuy – kuppa, uleshannotah lechol ma sheyyirtzu.
Verashshain bene hair lehatenot al hammiddot, veal hashshearim, veal sechar poalim; ulehassia al kitzatan.
Amar mar: en osin serarot al hatztzibbur pachot mishshenayim. mena hane mille? amar rav nachman, amar kera: "vehem yikchu et hazzahav vegomer".
Serarot hu dela avdi, ha hemone meheman – mesayyay leh lerabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: maase uminna rabbi shene achin al hakkuppa.

May seraruta? deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lefi shemmemashkenin al hatztzedaka, vaafillu beerev shabbat. inni? veha ketiv: "ufakadti al kol lochatzav", veamar rabbi yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav: vaafillu al gabbae tzedaka!
La kashya; ha daamid, ha dela amid. ki ha derava achpeye lerav natan bar amme, ushekayl minneh arba mea zuze litzdaka.
"Vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia vegomer"; "hammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia" – ze dayyayn sheddan din emet laamitto. "umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed" – ellu gabbae tzedaka.

Bematnita tana: "vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia" – ze dayyayn sheddan din emet laamitto, vegabbae tzedaka. "umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed" – ellu melammede tinokot. kegon man? amar rav: kegon rav shemuel bar shilat. derav ashkecheh lerav shemuel bar shilat dahava kae beginneta, amar leh: shevakteh lehemanutach? amar leh: ha telesar shenin dela chazya li, vehasheta name datay illavayhu.
Verabbanan may? amar ravina: "veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato".

Tanu rabbanan: gabbae tzedaka enan rashshain lifrosh ze mizze, aval poresh ze lashshaar veze lachanut. matza maot bashshuk – lo yittenem betoch kiso; ella notnan letoch arnaki shel tzedaka, ulichsheyyavo leveto yittelem. kayyotze bo, haya noshe bachavero mane, uferao bashshuk – lo yittenennu letoch kiso, ella notnan letoch arnaki shel tzedaka, ulichsheyyavo leveto yatlem.

Tanu rabbanan: gabbae tzedaka sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek – portin laacherim, veen portin leatzman. gabbae tamchuy sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek – mochrin laacherim veen mochrin leatzman. maot shel tzedaka – en monin otan shetayim, ella achat achat.

Amar abbaye: meresh la hava yatev mar atztzippe deve chenishta. kevan deshama leha detanya: "uleshannotah lechol ma sheyyirtzu", hava yatev. amar abbaye: meresh hava aved mar tere chise – chad laaniyye dealma, vechad laaniyye demata. kevan deshama leha daamar leh shemuel lerav tachlifa bar avdimi: "aved chad kisa,

a: Veatni ala"; ihu name avad chad kisa, veatni ala. rav ashe amar: ana – atnoye name la tzerichna, dechol deka ate addata didi ate, uleman devaena yahevna leh.

Hanhu be tere tabbache deavdi inyayna bahade hadade, dechol man deaved beyoma dechavreh – nikreu lemashkeh. azal chad minnayyhu avad beyoma dechavreh, kerau lemashkeh. ato lekammeh derava, chayyeyvinhu rava leshallome.

Etiveh rav yemar bar shelemya lerava: "ulehassia al kitzatam"! la ahdar leh rava. amar rav pappa: shappir avad dela ahdar leh midde; hane mille hecha delekka adam chashuv, aval hecha deikka adam chashuv – lav kol keminnayyhu dematnu.

Tanu rabbanan: en mechashshevin bitzdaka im gabbae tzedaka, velo behekdesh im haggizbarin. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar – shenneemar: "velo yechashshevu et haanashim asher yittenu et hakkesef al yadam latet leose hammelacha, ki veemuna hem osim".
Amar rabbi elazar: af al pi sheyyesh lo laadam gizbar neeman betoch beto – yatzur veyimne, shenneemar: vayyatzuru vayyimnu.
Amar rav huna: bodkin limzonot, veen bodkin lichsut – i baet ema kera, vei baet ema sevara;

I baet ema sevara – hay ka mibbazze, vehay la ka mibbazze. i baet ema kera – "halo faros laraev lachmecha"; beshin ketiv – perosh, vahadar hav leh. vehatam ketiv: "ki tire arom vechissito"; "ki tire" – lealtar.
Verav yehuda amar: bodkin lichsut, veen bodkin limzonot – i baet ema sevara, vei baet ema kera;

I baet ema sevara – hay kamtzaara leh, vehay la kamtzaara leh. i baet ema kera – hacha ketiv: "halo faros laraev lachmecha" – peros lealtar, uchedikrenan; vehatam ketiv: "ki tire arom vechissito" – kesheyyerae lecha. tanya kevoteh derav yehuda: amar "kassuni" – bodkin acharav. "parnesuni" – en bodkin.

Tenan hatam: en pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom, mikkikkar befunedyon – mearba sein besela. lan – notnin lo parnasat lina. may "parnasat lina"? amar rav pappa: pureya uve sadya. shavat – notnin lo mezon shalosh seudot. tana: im haya mechazzer al happetachim – en nizkakin lo.

Hahu anya dahava mechazzer al happetachim, daata lekammeh derav pappa – la mizdekik leh. amar leh rav samma bereh derav yeva lerav pappa: i mar la mizdekik leh, inash acharina la mizdekik leh! lemut leh?! veha tanya: im haya ani hamechazzer al happetachim – en nizkakin lo! amar leh: en nizkakin lo lemattana merubba, aval nizkakin lo lemattana muetet.

Amar rav assi: leolam al yimna adam atzmo [millatet] shelishit hashshekel beshana, shenneemar: "veheemadnu alenu mitzvot latet alenu shelishit hashshekel bashshana laavodat bet elohenu". veamar rav assi: shekula tzedaka keneged kol hammitzvot, shenneemar: "veheemadnu alenu mitzvot vegomer" – "mitzva" en ketiv kan, ella "mitzvot".

(Siman: gadol, mikdash, moshe) amar rabbi elazar: gadol hameasse yoter min haose – shenneemar: "vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom, vaavodat hatztzedaka hasheket vavetach ad olam"; zacha – "halo faros laraev lachmecha". lo zacha – "vaaniyyim merudim tavi vayit".

Amar lehu rava livne machoza: bematuta manayychu, usu bahade hadade, ki hechi delehve lechu shelama bemalchuta. veamar rabbi elazar: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, adam shokel shiklo – umitkapper lo; achshav sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym, im osin tzedaka – mutav, veim lav – bain ummot haolam venotlin bizroa. veaf al pi chen nechshav lahen litzdaka – shenneemar: "venogsayich tzedaka".
Amar rava: hay milleta ishtai li ulla
b: "Meshaggesh orchatay deimmeh", mishshemeh derabbi elazar – may dichtiv: "vayyilbash tzedaka kashshiryon"? lomar lach: ma shiryon ze – kol kelippa ukelippa mitztarefet leshiryon gadol, af tzedaka – kol peruta uferuta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol. rabbi chanina amar mehacha: "ucheveged iddim kol tzidkotenu"; ma beged ze – kol nima venima mitztarefet leveged gadol, af tzedaka – kol peruta uferuta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol.
Ammay karu leh "ulla meshaggesh orchatay deimmeh"? diva minneh rav achadvuy bar amme merav sheshet: minnayin limtzora bime seforo, shemtamme adam? amar lo: hoil umetamme begadim, metamme adam.
Amar leh: dilma tumea bechibburim shane, deha hesit nevela – dimtamme begadim, veeno metamme adam!

Amar leh: veella sheretz dimtamme adam – menalan? lav mishshum dimtamme begadim?! amar leh: sheretz behedya ketiv beh: "o ish asher yigga bechol sheretz". ella shichvat zera dimtamme adam – menalan? lav mishshum dehoil umetamme begadim, metamme adam? amar leh: shichvat zera name behedya ketiv beh: "o ish" – lerabbot et hannogea.

Ahdar leh bivdichuta. chalash dateh derav sheshet, ishtik rav achadvuy bar amme veityakkar talmudeh. atya immeh veka bachya kammeh, tzavvcha tzavvcha vela ashgach bah. amara leh: chazi lehane chadye dimtzet minnayyhu. bea rachame aleh, veittassi.
Vedaatan ala; mena lan? kidtanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: neemar kibbus begadim bime seforo, veneemar kibbus begadim bime chilluto, ma lehallan metamme adam – af kan metamme adam.

Amar rabbi elazar: gadol haose tzedaka basseter, yoter mimmoshe rabbenu – deillu bemoshe rabbenu ketiv: "ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema", veillu beose tzedaka ketiv: "mattan basseter yichpe af, [veshochad bachek chema azza]". ufeliga derabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: af kofe, chema eno kofe; shenneemar: "veshochad bachek chema azza" – af al pi sheshshochad bachek – chema azza. ikka deamri, amar rabbi yitzchak: kol dayyayn shennotel shochad – mevi chema azza laolam [shenneemar: veshochad bachek vegomer].

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol hannoten peruta leani – mitbarech beshesh berachot, vehamefayyeyso bidvarim – mitbarech beachat esre berachot. hannoten peruta leani mitbarech beshesh berachot – dichtiv: "halo faros vegomer, vaaniyyim merudim tavi vayit (vegomer) ki tire arom vegomer".

Vehamefayyeyso bidvarim mitbarech beachat esre berachot – shenneemar: "vetafek laraev nafshecha venefesh naana tasbia, vezarach bachoshech orecha vaafelatcha katztzohorayim. venachacha Adonai tamid, vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha vegomer, uvanu mimmecha chorvot olam, mosde dor vador tekomem vegomer".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "rodef tzedaka vachased yimtza chayyim tzedaka vechavod"? mishshum derodef tzedaka – yimtza tzedaka?! ella lomar lach: kol harodef achar tzedaka – hakkadosh baruch hu mamtzi lo maot veose bahen tzedaka.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: hakkadosh baruch hu mamtzi lo bene adam hamehugganim laasot lahen tzedaka, kede lekabbel alehem secharo. leappoke may? leappoke middedaresh rabba – dedaresh rabba, may dichtiv: "veyihyu muchshalim lefanecha, beet appecha ase bahem"? amar yirmeya lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, [afillu] beshaa shekkofin et yitzran umevakkeshin laasot tzedaka lefanecha, hacheshilem bivne adam sheenan mehugganin, kede shello yekabbelu alehen sachar.
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: kol haragil laasot tzedaka – zoche, havyin lo banim baale chochma, baale osher, baale aggada. baale chochma – dichtiv:

a: "Yimtza chayyim". baale osher – dichtiv: "tzedaka". baale aggada – dichtiv: "vechavod" – ketiv hacha: "vechavod", uchetiv hatam: "kavod chachamim yinchalu".

Tanya: haya rabbi meir omer, yesh lo levaal haddin lahashivcha velomar lecha: im elohechem ohev aniyyim hu, mippene ma eno mefarnesan? emor lo: kede shennitztzol anu bahen middinah shel gehinnam. vezo sheela shaal toranuserufus harasha et rabbi akiva: im elohechem ohev aniyyim hu, mippene ma eno mefarnesam? amar lo: kede shennitztzol anu bahen middinah shel gehinnam.

Amar lo: [adderabba], zo shemmechayyayvtan legehinnam! emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam shekkaas al avdo, vachavasho bevet haasurin, vetzivva alav shello lehaachilo veshello lehashekoto. vehalach adam echad veheechilo vehishkahu. kesheshshama hammelech, lo koes alav? veattem keruyin avadim, shenneemar: "ki li vene yisrael avadim"!

Amar lo rabbi akiva, emshol lecha mashal: lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam shekkaas al beno vachavasho bevet haasurin, vetzivva alav shello lehaachilo veshello lehashekoto. vehalach adam echad veheechilo vehishkahu. kesheshshama hammelech, lo doron meshagger lo?! vaanan keruyin banim, dichtiv: "banim attem laAdonai elohechem"!

Amar lo: attem keruyim banim ukeruyin avadim, bizman sheattem osin retzono shel makom attem keruyin banim, uvizman sheen attem osin retzono shel makom attem keruyin avadim; veachshav en attem osim retzono shel makom! amar lo, hare hu omer: "halo faros laraev lachmecha vaaniyyim merudim tavi vayit"; ematay "aniyyim merudim tavi vayit" – haiddana, vekaamar: "halo faros laraev lachmecha".

Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi shalom: keshem shemmezonotav shel adam ketzuvin lo merosh hashshana, kach chesronotav shel adam ketzuvin lo merosh hashshana. zacha – "halo faros laraev lachmecha". lo zacha – "vaaniyyim merudim tavi vayit".

Ki ha divne achateh derabban yochanan ben zakkay, chaza lehu bechelma devau lemichsar sheva mea dinare. assinhu shekal minnayyhu litzdaka, push gabbayyhu shivsar dinare. ki meta maale yoma dechippure, shaddur deve kesar naktinhu.

Amar lehu rabban yochanan ben zakkay: la tidchalun, shivsar dinare gabbayychu shaklinhu minnayychu. amri leh: mena yadat? amar lehu: chelma chazay lechu. amaru leh: veammay la amart lan [denittevinhu]? amar lehu: amena, ki hechi detabedu mitzva lishmah.

Rav pappa hava salek bedarga, ishtemit kareh bae lemippal. amar: hasheta (ken) [ku], ichayyayv man desane lan kimchallele shabbatot ucheovde avoda zara. amar leh chiyyay bar rav middifti lerav pappa: shemma ani ba leyadcha velo pirnasto.

Detanya, rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: kol hammaalim enav min hatztzedaka, keillu oved avoda zara – ketiv hacha: "hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha beliyyaal", uchetiv hatam: "yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal"; ma lehallan avoda zara, af kan avoda zara.

Tanya, amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: kol tzedaka vachased sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze, shalom gadol uferaklitin gedolin ben yisrael laavihen shebbashshamayim – shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai, al tavo bet marzeach veal telech lispod veal tanod lahem, ki asafti et shelomi meet haam hazze vegomer [et] hachesed veet harachamim"; "chesed" – zo gemilut chasadim, "rachamim" – zo tzedaka.

Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: gedola tzedaka shemmekarevet et haggeulla, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai, shimru mishpat vaasu tzedaka, ki kerova yeshuati lavo vetzidkati lehiggalot". hu haya omer, asara devarim kashim nivreu baolam: har kashe – barzel mechattecho, barzel kashe – ur mefapeo, ur kashe – mayim mechabbin oto, mayim kashim – avim sovlim otan, avim kashim – ruach mefazzartan, ruach kashe – guf sovlo, guf kashe – pachad shovro, pachad kashe – yayin mefigo, yayin kashe – shena mefakkachto; umita – kasha mikkullam [utzedaka matztzelet min hammita] – dichtiv: "utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet".

Daresh rabbi dostay berabbi yannay: bo uree, shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu – middat basar vadam; middat basar vadam, adam mevi doron gadol lammelech – safek mekabbelin oto hemennu, safek en mekabbelin oto hemennu; [veim timtza lomar mekabbelim oto mimmennu –] safek roe pene hammelech, safek eno roe pene hammelech. vehakkadosh baruch hu eno ken, adam noten peruta leani – zoche umekabbel pene shechina, shenneemar: "ani betzedek echeze fanecha, esbea vehakitz temunatecha".

Rabbi elazar yahev peruta leani, vahadar metzalle – amar, dichtiv: "ani betzedek echeze fanecha". may "esbea vehakitz temunatecha"? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ellu talmide chachamim shemmenaddedin shena meenehem baolam hazze, vehakkadosh baruch hu masbian mizziv hashshechina laolam habba.
Amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "malve Adonai chonen dal"? ilmale mikra katuv i efshar leomro – kivyachol "eved love leish malve".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: rabbi yochanan rame, ketiv: "lo yoil hon beyom evra, utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet", uchetiv: "lo yoilu otzrot resha, utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet" – shete tzedakot hallalu lamma? achat shemmatztzilato mimmita meshunna, veachat shemmatztzilato middinah shel gehinnam. vee zo hi shemmatztzilato middinah shel gehinnam? hahu dichtiv beh "evra" – dichtiv: "yom evra hayyom hahu". vee zo hi shemmatztzilato mimmita meshunna?
b: Notnah – veeno yodea lemi notnah, notlah – veeno yodea mimmi notlah. notnah veeno yodea lemi notnah – leappoke middemar ukeva; notlah veeno yodea mimmi notlah – leappoke midderabbi abba. veella hechi lebed? littev learnaki shel tzedaka.

Metivi: ma yaase adam veyihyu lo banim zecharim? rabbi eliezer omer: yefazzer meotav laaniyyim. rabbi yehoshua omer: yesammach ishto lidvar mitzva. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: lo yitten adam peruta learnaki shel tzedaka, ella im ken memunne aleha kerabbi chananya ben teradyon! ki ka amrinan – dimmanne ala kerabbi chananya ben teradyon.
Amar rabbi avahu, amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, bamme tarum keren yisrael? amar lo: bechi tissa".

Veamar rabbi avahu, shaalu et shelomo ben david: ad hechan kochah shel tzedaka? amar lahen, tzeu ureu ma peresh david abba: "pizzar natan laevyonim – tzidkato omedet laad, karno tarum bechavod". rabbi abba amar mehacha: "hu meromim yishkon, metzadot selaim misgabbo, lachmo nittan, memav neemanim"; ma taam "meromim yishkon, metzadot selaim misgabbo" – mishshum delachmo nittan" umemav neemanim".

Veamar rabbi avahu, shaalu et shelomo: ezehu ben haolam habba? amar lahem: kol shekkeneged zekenav kavod. ki ha deyosef bereh derabbi yehoshua chalash, innegid. amar leh avu: may chazet? amar leh: olam hafuch raiti – elyonim lematta, vetachtonim lemala. amar leh: olam barur raita. vaanan, hechi chazetinnan? [amar leh:] ki hechi dachashivinan hacha, chashivinan hatam.

Veshamati shehayu omrim: ashre mi shebba lechan – vetalmudo beyado. veshamati shehayu omrim: haruge malchut – en kol beriyya yechola laamod bimchitzatan. man ninhu? ilema rabbi akiva vachaverav, mishshum haruge malchut – vetu la?! peshita, belav hachi name! ella haruge lod.

Tanya, amar lahen rabban yochanan ben zakkay letalmidav: banay, mahu sheamar hakkatuv: "tzedaka teromem goy, vechesed leummim chattat"? naana rabbi eliezer veamar: "tzedaka teromem goy" – ellu yisrael, dichtiv: "umi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz"; "vachased leummim chattat" – kol tzedaka vachesed sheummot haolam osin, chet hu lahen; sheenam osin ella lehitgaddel bo, kemo shenneemar: "di lehevon mehakervin nichochin leelah shemayya, umetzallayin lechayye malka uvenohi".
Udeaved hachi, lav tzedaka gemura hi?! vehatanya, haomer: "sela ze litzdaka, bishvil sheyyichyu banay", uvishvil sheezke laolam habba" – hare ze tzaddik gamur! la kashya; kan beyisrael, kan begoy.

Naana rabbi yehoshua veamar: "tzedaka teromem goy" – ellu yisrael, dichtiv: "umi keammecha yisrael goy echad"; "vachased leummim chattat" – kol tzedaka vachesed sheummot haolam osin, chet hu lahen; sheen osin ella kede shettimmashech malchutan, shenneemar: "lahen malka, milki yishpar alach, vachatayacha betzidka feruk, vaavayatach bemichan anayin, hen teheve archa lishlevtach vegomer".

Naana rabban gamliel veamar: "tzedaka teromem goy" – ellu yisrael, "dichtiv: umi keammecha yisrael [vegomer]"; "vechesed leummim chattat" – kol tzedaka vachesed sheggoyim osin, chet hu lahen; sheen osin ella lehityaher bo, vechol hammityaher nofel begehinnam – shenneemar: "zed yahir letz shemo, ose beevrat zadon" – veen "evra" ella gehinnam, shenneemar: "yom evra hayyom hahu".

Amar rabban gamliel: adayin anu tzerichin lammodai – rabbi eliezer hammodai omer: "tzedaka teromem goy" – ellu yisrael, dichtiv: "umi keammecha yisrael goy echad"; "vachesed leummim chattat" – kol tzedaka vachesed sheummot haolam osin, chet hu lahen; sheen osin ella lecharef otanu bo, shenneemar: "vayyavo vayyaas Adonai kaasher dibber, ki chatatem laAdonai velo shematem bekolo, vehaya lachem haddavar hazze".

Naana rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana veamar: "tzedaka teromem goy vachesed" – leyisrael; uleummim – chattat". amar lahem rabban yochanan ben zakkay letalmidav: nirin divre rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana middevaray umiddivrechem, lefi shehu noten tzedaka vachesed leyisrael, velaummot chattat. mikkelal dehu name amar; may hi? detanya, amar lahem rabban yochanan ben zakkay: keshem shehachattat mechapperet al yisrael – kach tzedaka mechapperet al ummot haolam.

Ifra hormiz immeh deshabbur malka, shaddara arba mea dinare lekammeh derabbi amme, vela kabbelinhu. shaddar[ti]ynhu kammeh derava, vekabbelinhu mishshum shelom malchut. shema rabbi amme, ikkefad, amar: let leh: "bivosh ketzirah tishshavarna, nashim baot meirot otah"?! verava – mishshum shelom malchut.
Verabbi amme name, mishshum shelom malchut! deibbei leh lemifleginhu laaniyye goyim. verava name – laaniyye goyim yahavinhu; verabbi amme deikkefad, hu

a: Dela sayyeymuha kammeh.

Tanya: amru alav al binyamin hatztzaddik, shehaya memunne al kuppa shel tzedaka; paam achat bata ishsha lefanav bishne vatztzoret, amra lo: rabbi, parneseni! amar lah: haavoda, sheen bekuppa shel tzedaka kelum! amra lo: rabbi, im en atta mefarneseni, hare ishsha veshiva baneha metim! amad ufirnesah mishshello. leyamim chala venata lamut, amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, atta amarta: kol hamekayyem nefesh achat miyyisrael, keillu kiyyem olam male; uvinyamin hatztzaddik, shehecheya ishsha veshiva baneha, yamut beshanim muatot hallalu? miyyad karu lo gezar dino. tana: hosifu lo esrim ushetayim shana al shenotav.

Tanu rabbanan: maase vemonbaz hammelech, shebbizbez otzrotav veotzrot avotav bishne batztzoret, vechavru alav echav uvet aviv, veamru lo: avotecha ganzu vehosifu al shel avotam, veatta mevazbezam! amar lahem: avotay ganzu lematta, vaani ganazti lemala – shenneemar: "emet meeretz titzmach, vetzedek mishshamayim nishkaf". avotay ganzu bimkom shehayyad sholetet bo, vaani ganazti bimkom sheen hayyad sholetet bo – shenneemar: "tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha".

Avotay ganzu davar sheen ose perot, vaani ganazti davar sheose perot – shenneemar: "imru tzaddik ki tov, ki feri maallehem yochelu". avotay ganzu [otzrot] mamon, vaani ganazti otzrot nefashot – shenneemar: "peri tzaddik etz chayyim, velokeach nefashot chacham". avotay ganzu laacherim, vaani ganazti leatzmi – shenneemar: "ulecha tihye tzedaka". avotay ganzu laolam hazze, vaani ganazti laolam habba – shenneemar: "vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha, kevod Adonai yaasfecha".
Veim kana bah bet dira – hare hu keanshe hair. matnitin dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel – detanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im kana bah karka kol shehu, hare hu keanshe hair.
Veha tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im kana sham karka haruya levet dira – hare hu keanshe hair! tere tannae, veallibba derabban shimon ben gamliel.

Mishna en cholkin et hechatzer – ad sheyyehe arba ammot laze, vearba ammot laze. velo et hassade – ad sheyyehe bah tisha kabbin laze, vetisha kabbin laze. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyehe bah tishat chatzaye kabbin laze, vetishat chatzaye kabbin laze. velo et hagginna – ad sheyyehe bah chatzi kav laze, vachatzi kav laze. rabbi akiva omer: bet rova.

Velo et hatteraklin, velo et hammoran, velo et hashshovach, velo et hattallit, velo et hammerchatz, velo et bet habbad, velo et bet hashshelachin – ad sheyyehe bahen keday laze ucheday laze. ze hakkelal: kol sheyyechalek, ushemo alav – cholkin, veim lav – en cholkin.
Ematay – bizman sheen shenehem rotzim; aval bizman sheshshenehem rotzim, afillu pachot mikkan – yachloku. vechitve hakkodesh, af al pi sheshshenehem rotzim – lo yachloku.

Gemara amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: arba ammot sheamru – chutz mishshel petachim. tanya name hachi: en cholkim et hechatzer – ad sheyyehe bah shemone ammot laze, ushemone ammot laze. veha anan tenan: arba ammot laze, vearba ammot laze! ella shema minna – kidrabbi assi; shema minna.

Veikka derame lehu mirme – tenan: en cholkin et hechatzer, ad sheyyehe bah arba ammot laze, vearba ammot laze. vehatanya: shemone ammot laze, ushemone ammot laze! amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: arba ammot sheamru – chutz mishshel petachim.
Amar rav huna: chatzer mitchalleket lefi petacheha. verav chisda amar: notnin arba ammot lechol petach ufetach, vehashshear cholkin beshave.

Tanya kevoteh derav chisda: petachim shebbechatzer – yesh lahen arba ammot. haya laze petach echad, velaze shene fetachim; ze sheyyesh lo petach echad – notel arba ammot, veze sheyyesh lo shene fetachim – notel shemone ammot; vehashshear cholkin beshave. haya laze petach rachav shemone ammot – notel shemone ammot keneged happetach, vearba ammot bechatzer. arba ammot bechatzer – may avidtayyhu? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: notel shemone ammot beorech hechatzer, vearba ammot berochav hechatzer.
Amar ammemar: hay pera desufele – yesh lo arba ammot lechol ruach varuach. vela amaran ella dela meyaychad leh pitcha,
b: Aval meyaychad leh pitcha – en lo ella arba ammot lifne fitcho.

Amar rav huna: achsadra – en lah arba ammot. tama may – mishshum peruk massao; hacha – efshar deayel legavvay umefarak. metiv rav sheshet: echad shaare vattim, veechad shaare achsadraot – yesh lahen arba ammot! ki tanya hahi, beachsadra deve rav. achsadra deve rav peshita – idderona mealleya hu! ella beachsadra romayyota.

Tanu rabbanan: bet shaar, achsadra umirpeset – yesh lahen arba ammot. hayu chamishsha battim petuchin lemirpeset – en lahen ella arba ammot bilvad. bea minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay: lul shel tarnegolin – yesh lo arba ammot, o en lo arba ammot? amar leh: tama may – mishshum peruk massao; hacha – metappes veole, metappes veyored.

Bea minneh rava merav nachman: bayit chetzyo mekore vechetzyo eno mekore – yesh lo arba ammot, o en lo arba ammot? amar leh: en lo arba ammot; la mibbaya keruyo millegav – deefshar deayel legavvay umefarek; ella afillu keruyo kelappe chutz – efshar deayel legavvay umefarek.
Bea minneh rav huna merabbi amme: echad mibbene mavoy, shebbikkesh lehachazir pitcho lemavoy acher – bene mavoy meakkevin alav, o en meakkevin alav? amar leh: bene mavoy meakkevin alav.

Achsanya – lefi bene adam mitchalleket, o lefi fetachim mitchalleket? amar leh: lefi bene adam mitchalleket. tanya name hachi: zevel shebbechatzer – mitchalleket lefi fetachim. achsanya – lefi bene adam.
Amar rav huna: echad mibbene mavoy shebbikkesh listom keneged pitcho – bene mavoy meakkevin alav, shemmarbe alehen et hadderech.

Metivi: chamesh chatzerot petuchot lemavoy – kullan mishtammeshot im hachitzona, vehachitzona mishtammeshet leatzmah. vehashshear mishtammeshot im hashsheniyya; vehashsheniyya mishtammeshet leatzmah umishtammeshet im hachitzona.
Nimtzet penimit mishtammeshet leatzmah, umishtammeshet im kol achat veachat.

Tannae hi. detanya: echad mibbene mavoy shebbikkesh lehachazir pitcho lemavoy acher – bene mavoy meakkevin alav. haya satum uvikkesh lefotcho – en bene mavoy meakkevin alav; divre rabbi. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: chamesh chatzerot happetuchot lemavoy – kullan mishtammeshot bammavoy zo im zo.

Chatzerot man dechar shemayyhu? chassore michassera, vehachi katane: vechen chamesh chatzerot happetuchot lemavoy – kullan mishtammeshot im hachitzona, vehachitzona mishtammeshet leatzmah vechulei; divre rabbi. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: chamesh chatzerot happetuchot lemavoy – kullam mishtammeshot bammavoy.

Amar mar: haya satum uvikkesh lefotcho – en bene mavoy meakkevin alav. amar rava: lo shanu ella shello paratz et patztzimav, aval paratz et patztzimav – bene mavoy meakkevin alav. amar leh abbaye lerava, tanya dimsayyay lach:

a: Bayit satum – yesh lo arba ammot; paratz et patztzimav – en lo arba ammot.
Kever sheppitcho satum – eno metamme kol sevivav; paratz et patztzimav, usetamo – metamme kol sevivav. bayit satum – eno metamme kol sevivav; paratz et patztzimav – metamme kol sevivav.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: mevoot hamefullashot leir acheret, uvikkeshu bene hair lesotman – bene otah hair meakkevin alehen. la mibbee ki lekka darka acharina – dimakkevi, ella afillu ki ikka darka acharina, name meakkevi –
Mishshum derav yehuda amar rav, deamar: metzer shehecheziku bo rabbim, asur lekalkelo – kidrav giddel, deamar rav giddel: rabbim shebberru derech leatzman – ma shebberru, berru.
Amar rav anan amar shemuel: mevoot hamefullashin lirshut harabbim, uvikkeshu bene mevoot lehaamid lahen delatot – bene reshut harabbim meakkevin alehen.

Sevur minna – hane mille bearba ammot, kidrabbi zera amar rav nachman – deamar rabbi zera amar rav nachman: arba ammot hassemuchot lirshut harabbim, kirshut harabbim damyayn; vela hi, hatam – leinyan tumea, aval hacha – zimnin dedachaki bene reshut harabbim, veayyli tuva.
Velo et hassade – ad sheyyehe bah tisha kabbin laze, vetisha kabbin laze kulei. vela peligi; mar ki atreh, umar ki atreh.
Bevavel may? amar rav yosef: be radu yoma.
May "be radu yoma"? i yoma zara – tere yoma kerava la have; i yoma kerava – yoma dezara la have!
I baet ema yoma dichrava – decharev vetane; vei baet ema yoma dezara – behadore.
Davvla – amar rav nachman: be dalu yoma. pardesa – amar avu dishmuel: bat sheloshet kabbin.

Tanya name hachi, haomer lachavero: "menat bakkerem ani mocher lecha" – somchos omer: lo yifchot mishshelosha kabbin. amar rabbi yose: en ellu ella divre neviut. bevavel may? amar rava bar kisna: telat atzyata bene teresar gufene – ki hechi derafek gavra beyoma.

Amar rabbi avdimi demin chefa: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, nittela nevua min hanneviim venittena lachachamim. attu chacham lav navi hu? hachi kaamar: af al pi shennittela min hanneviim, min hachachamim lo nittela.
Amar ammemar: vechacham adif minnavi, shenneemar: "venavi levav chochma" – mi nitle bemi? heve omer: katan nitle baggadol.

Amar abbaye: tidda, deamar gavra rabba milleta, umitamra mishshemeh degavra rabba acharina kevoteh. amar rava: umay kusheya? vedilma tarvayyhu bene chad mazzala ninhu! ella amar rava: tidda, deamar gavra rabba milleta, umitamra
b: Mishshemeh derabbi akiva bar yosef kevoteh. amar rav ashe: umay kusheya? dilma leha milleta bar mazzaleh hu!
Ella amar rav ashe: tidda, deamar gavra rabba milleta, umitamra halacha lemoshe missinay kevoteh. vedilma kesome baarubba! velav taam yehev?!

Amar rabbi yochanan: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, nittela nevua min hanneviim venittena lashshotim velattinokot. lashshotim – may hi? ki ha demar bar rav ashe – dahava kae beristeka demachoza, shameh lehahu shote dekaamar: resh metivta demalech bemata machseya – "tavyome" chatem. amar: man chatem "tavyome" berabbanan – ana; shema minna ledidi kayyma li shata. kam ata. addaata immeno rabbanan leotoveh lerav acha middifti beresha.

Kevan deshami daata, shaddur zuga derabbanan legabbeh leimmeloche beh. akkeveh. hadar shaddur zuga derabbanan acharina, akkeveh gabbeh. ad dimlo be asra. kevan dimlo be asra, petach hu utena uderash. lefi sheen potchin bechalla pachot measara.
Kare rav acha annafsheh: kol hammeriin lo – lo bimhera metivin lo, vechol hammetivin lo – lo bimhera meriin lo.
Tinokot – may hi? ki ha devat rav chisda – hava yatva bechanfeh daavuha, havo yatvi kammeh rava verame bar chama. amar la: man minnayyhu baet? amara leh: tarvayyhu. amar rava: vaana batra.

Amar rabbi avdimi demin chefa: kodem sheyyochal adam veyishte, yesh lo shete levavot; leachar sheochel veshote – en lo ella lev echad. shenneemar: "ish navuv yillavev" – uchetiv: "nevuv luchot", umetargeminan: chalil luchin.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: haragil beyayin, afillu libbo atum kivtula – yayin mefakkecho, shenneemar: "vetirosh yenovev betulot".
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: peshita, chelek bechor vechelek pashut – yahavinan leh achad mitzra. yavam – may?
Amar abbaye: hi – hi; may tama? "bechor" karyeh rachamana. rava amar, amar kera: "vehaya habbechor" – havayayto kivchor, veen chalukkato kivchor.
Hahu dizvan ara ammitzra deve nesheh. ki ka palgu, amar lehu: peligu li ammitzray. amar rabba: kegon ze – kofin al middat sedom.
Matkef la rav yosef: amri leh ache, meallinan leh illuya ki nichse deve bar mariyyon! vehilcheta kerav yosef.
Tere arata attere nigre – amar rabba: kegon ze – kofin al middat sedom. matkef la rav yosef: zimnin dehay middevil vehay la middevil! vehilcheta kerav yosef.
Tarte achad nigra – amar rav yosef: kegon ze – kofin al middat sedom. matkef la abbaye, matze amar: baena deappesh arise! vehilcheta kerav yosef; apposhe lav milleta hi.

a: Chad gisa nigra vechad gisa nahara – palgin la bekarna zol.
Velo et hatteraklin kulei. en bahen keday laze uchede laze, mahu? rav yehuda amar: it dina degud, o eggud". rav nachman amar: let dina degud, o eggud".

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: ledidach deamrat let dina degud o eggud", bechor ufashut shehinniach lahen avihen eved uvehema temea, ketzad osin? amar leh, sheani omer: oved laze yom echad, velaze shene yamim.

Metivi: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin – oved et rabbo yom echad, veet atzmo yom echad; divre bet hillel. bet shammay omrim: tikkantem et rabbo; et atzmo lo tikkantem! lissa shifcha – eno yachol, lissa bat chorin – eno yachol; yibbatel?! vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya ureviyya, shenneemar: "lo tohu veraah, lashevet yetzarah"!
Ella kofin et rabbo – veosin oto ben chorin, vechotvin shetar al chatzi damav. vechazru bet hillel lehorot kedivre bet shammay!
Shane hacha, deeggud" ikka, "gud" lekka.
Ta shema: shene achin – echad ani veechad ashir, vehinniach lahen avihen merchatz uvet habbad; asaan lesachar – hassachar laemtza; asaan leatzmo – hare ashir omer leani:
b: "Kach lecha avadim veyirchatzu bammerchatz", "kach lecha zetim, uvo vaase bevet habbad"! hatam name, "gud" ikka, "eggud" lekka.
Ta shema: kol sheillu yechalek ushemo alav – cholkin, im lav – maalin oto bedamim! tannae hi – detanya: "tol atta shiur, vaani pachot" – shomin lo. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en shomin lo.

Hechi dame? illema kidtane – may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel? ella lav chassore mechassera, vehachi kaamar: "tol atta shiur vaani pachot" – shomin lo. vegud o eggud" – name shomin lo. vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar: en shomin lo?
La, leolam kidkatane; udekaamrat: may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel? mishshum deamar leh: i bidme – let li deme lemittan lach; bemattana – la nicha li, dichtiv: "vesone mattanot yichye".

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha derav yehuda – dishmuel hi, ditnan: vechitve hakkodesh, af al pi sheshshenehem rotzim – lo yachloku. veamar shemuel: lo shanu ella becherech echad, aval bishne kerichot – cholkin. vei salka datach let dina degud" o "eggud", may irya becherech echad? afillu bishne kerichin name!
Targema rav shalman – besheshshenehen rotzin.

Amar ammemar, hilcheta: it dina degud" o "eggud". amar leh rav ashe leammemar: ha derav nachman, may? amar leh: la shemia li; kelomar, la sevira li. vela?! veha ravin bar chinnana verav dimi bar chinnana shevak lehu avu tarte amhata, chada yada afya uvashshole, vachada yada pilka venavvla; vaato lekammeh derava, vaamar lehu: let dina degud" o "eggud"!

Shane hatam – dilmar mibbee leh tarvayyhu, ulemar mibbee leh tarvayyhu; ki kaamar leh: shekol at chada vaana chada – lav "gud" o "eggud" hu. vechi la matze lememar hachi?! veha kitve hakkodesh, detarvayyhu mibbee lehu, veamar shemuel: lo shanu ella becherech echad, aval bishne kerichin – cholkin! ha targema rav shalman besheratzu.

Tanu rabbanan: madbik adam tora neviim uchetuvim keechad, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: tora bifne atzmah, neviim bifne atzman, uchetuvim bifne atzman. vachachamim omrim: kol echad veechad bifne atzmo.

Veamar rabbi yehuda: maase bevaytos ben zonin, shehayu lo shemona neviim medubbakin keechad, al pi rabbi elazar ben azarya. veyesh omrim: lo hayu lo ella echad echad bifne atzmo. amar rabbi: maase veheviu lefanenu tora neviim uchetuvim medubbakim keechad, vehichsharnum.
Ben chummash lechummash shel tora – arbaa shitin; vechen ben kol navi lenavi. uvenavi shel shenem asar – shalosh shitin. umesayyem millematta, umatchil millemala.
Tanu rabbanan: harotze ledabbek tora neviim uchetuvim keechad – medabbek; veose berosho kede lagol ammud, uvesofo kede lagol hekkef; umesayyem millematta umatchil millemala;

a: Veim ba lachtoch – chotech. may kaamar? hachi kaamar: sheim ba lachtoch – chotech.
Ureminhi: techillat sefer vesofo – kede lagol. kede lagol may? i kede lagol ammud – kashya hekkef; i kede lagol hekkef – kashya ammud!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: litzdadin katane.

Rav ashe amar: ki tanya hahi – besefer tora. kidtanya: kol hassefarim niglalim mittechillatan lesofan; vesefer tora niglal leemtzaito, veose lo ammud elach veelach. amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok: kach hayu kotve sefarim shebbirushalayim osin sifrehem.
Tanu rabbanan: en osin sefer tora – lo orko yoter al hekkefo, velo hekkefo yoter al orko. shaalu et rabbi: shiur sefer tora bechamma? amar lahen: bigvil – shishsha. biklaf bechamma? eni yodea.
Rav huna ketav shivin sifre deorayyta, vela itremi leh ella chad. rav acha bar yaakov ketav chad ammashkeh deigle, veitremi leh. yehavu beh rabbanan enayyhu, venach nafsheh.

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav hamenuna: ketav rabbi amme arba mea sifre tora. amar lehu: dilma "tora tzivva lanu moshe" ketav. amar leh rava lerabbi zera: neta rabbi yannay arba mea karme. amar leh: dilma shetayim keneged shetayim, veachat yotze zanav.
Metivi: aron sheasa moshe – ammatayim vachetzi orko, veamma vachetzi rochbo, veamma vachetzi komato – beamma bat shishsha tefachim.

Vehalluchot – orkan shishsha, verochban shishsha, veovyayn shelosha; munnachot keneged orko shel aron. kamma luchot ochlot baaron – shenem asar tefachim. nishtayyeyru sham shelosha tefachim. tze mehen tefach – chetzyo lechotel ze vechetzyo lechotel ze – nishtayyeyru sham shene tefachim, shebbahen sefer tora munnach.
Shenneemar: "en baaron rak shene luchot haavanim asher hinniach sham moshe [vegomer]" – may "en baaron rak"? miut achar miut; veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot – sefer tora shemmunnach baaron.

Pirnasta aron leorko; tze ufarnes aron lerochbo – kamma luchot ochlot baaron? shishsha tefachim. nishtayyeyru sham shelosha tefachim; tze mehen tefach – chetzyo lechotel ze vechetzyo lechotel ze – nishtayyeyru sham shene tefachim, shello yehe sefer tora nichnas veyotze keshehu dachuk; divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yehuda omer: beamma bat chamishsha tefachim. vehalluchot – orkan shishsha, verochban shishsha, veovyayn shelosha; munnachot beorko shel aron. kamma luchot ochlot baaron – shenem asar tefachim; nishtayyer sham chatzi tefach – etzba lechotel ze veetzba lechotel ze.

Pirnasta aron leorko; tze ufarnes aron lerochbo – kamma luchot ogdot baaron? shishsha tefachim. nishtayyer sham tefach umechetza; tze mehen chatzi tefach – etzba umechetza lechotel ze veetzba umechetza lechotel ze – nishtayyer sham tefach, shebbo ammudin omdin – shenneemar: "appiryon asa lo hammelech shelomo meatze hallevanon, ammudav asa chesef, refidato zahav, merkavo argaman vegomer".

Veargaz sheshshiggeru bo pelishtim doron lelohe yisrael munnach mitztziddo, shenneemar: "veet kele hazzahav asher hashevotem lo, asham tasimu vaargaz mitztziddo, veshillachtem oto vehalach". vealav sefer tora munnach, shenneemar: "lakoach et sefer hattora hazze, vesamtem oto mitztzad aron berit Adonai" – mitztzad hu munnach, velo betocho.
Uma ani mekayyem "en baaron rak"? lerabbot
b: Shivre luchot shemmunnachim baaron. vei salka datach sefer tora hekkefo shishsha tefachim; mikkede kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim – yesh bo rochav tefach, vechevan dilemtzaito niglal – nefish leh mittere tifcha ravvcha devene bene; bitre pusheche hechi yatev?
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: sefer azara litchillato hu niglal. veakkatti, tere bitre hechi yatev? amar rav ashe: decharech beh pureta, vecharcheh leel.

Verabbi yehuda – mikkamme delayte argaz, sefer tora hechi hava yatev? dappa hava nafek minneh, veyatev illave sefer tora. verabbi meir – hay "mitztzad aron", may aved leh? hahu mibbee leh demittenach leh mitztzad vela mittenach bene luche; uleolam begavveh – min hatztzad.

Verabbi meir, ammudin hecha havo kayymi? mibbaray. verabbi meir, shivre luchot demunnachin baaron – mena leh? nafka leh midderav huna – deamar rav huna, may dichtiv: "asher nikra shem shem Adonai tzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim alav"? melammed shelluchot veshivre luchot munnachim baaron.
Veiddach – hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi shimon ben yochay: melammed, shehashshem vechol kinnuyav munnachin baaron.

Veiddach name mibbee leh lehachi! en hachi name. ella shivre luchot demunnachin baaron mena leh? nafka leh middetane rav yosef – detane rav yosef: "asher shibbarta vesamtam" – melammed shehalluchot veshivre luchot munnachin baaron.
Veiddach – hahu mibbee leh lechidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: "asher shibbarta" – amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: yishar kochacha sheshshibbarta.

Tanu rabbanan, sidran shel neviim: yehoshua veshoftim, shemuel umelachim, yirmeya vichezkel, yeshaya ushenem asar. mikkede hoshea kadem; dichtiv: "techillat dibber Adonai behoshea" – vechi im hoshea dibber techilla? vahalo mimmoshe vead hoshea kamma neviim hayu! veamar rabbi yochanan: shehaya techilla learbaa neviim shennitnabbeu beoto happerek – veellu hen: hoshea vishaya, amos umicha; velaykdemeh lehoshea beresha!
Kevan dichtiv nevuateh gabbe chaggay zecharya umalachi, vechaggay zecharya umalachi sof neviim havo – chashev leh bahadayyhu. velichteveh lechodeh, velaykdemeh! ayyeyde dezutar mirchas.

Mikkedi yeshaya kadem miyyirmeya vichezkel, laykdemeh lishaya beresha! kevan dimlachim sofeh churebana; veyirmeya kulleh churebana; vichezkel resheh churebana vesefeh nechamta; vishaya kulleh nechamta – samchinan churebana lechurebana, venechamta lenechamta.

Sidran shel ketuvim: rut vesefer tehillim veiyyov umishle, kohelet, shir hashshirim vekinot, daniel umegilat ester, ezra vedivre hayyamim. uleman deamar: iyyov bime moshe haya, laykdemeh leiyyov beresha! atchole befureanuta la matchalinan. rut name pureanut hi! pureanut deit leh acharit – deamar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra shemah rut? sheyyatza mimmenna david, sherivvahu lehakkadosh baruch hu beshirot vetushebachot.

Umi ketavan? moshe katav sifro ufarashat bilam veiyyov. yehoshua katav sifro ushemona pesukim shebbattora. shemuel katav sifro veshoftim verut. david katav sefer tehillim – al yede asara zekenim: al yede adam harishon, al yede malki tzedek, veal yede avraham, veal yede moshe, veal yede heman, veal yede yedutun, veal yede asaf,

a: Veal yede shelosha bene korach.

Yirmeya katav sifro vesefer melachim vekinot. chizkiyya vesiato katvu (yimshak siman:) yeshaya, mishle, shir hashshirim vekohelet. anshe keneset haggedola katvu (kandag siman:) yechezkel ushenem asar, daniyyel umegilat ester. ezra katav sifro, veyachas shel divre hayyamim ad lo.
Mesayyeya leh lerav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: lo ala ezra mibbavel, ad sheyyiches atzmo veala. uman assekeh? nechemya ben chachalya.

Amar mar: yehoshua katav sifro ushemona pesukim shebbattora. tanya keman deamar: shemona pesukim shebbattora yehoshua ketavan. detanya "vayyamot sham moshe eved Adonai" – efshar moshe met, vechatav: "vayyamot sham moshe"?! ella ad kan katav moshe, mikkan veelach katav yehoshua; divre rabbi yehuda, veamri la rabbi nechemya.

Amar lo rabbi shimon: efshar sefer tora chaser ot achat, uchetiv: "lakoach et sefer hattora hazze"?! ella ad kan hakkadosh baruch hu omer – umoshe omer vechotev; mikkan veelach hakkadosh baruch hu omer – umoshe kotev bedema, kemo shenneemar lehallan: "vayyomer lahem baruch: mippiv yikra elay et kol haddevarim haelle, vaani kotev al hassefer baddeyo".

Keman azla ha deamar rabbi yehoshua bar abba amar rav giddel amar rav: shemona pesukim shebbattora yachid kore otan? lema rabbi yehuda hi – udela kerabbi shimon? afillu tema rabbi shimon, hoil veishtanno – ishtanno.
Yehoshua katav sifro. vehachtiv: "vayyamot yehoshua bin nun eved Adonai"! deassekeh elazar. vehachtiv: "veelazar ben aharon met"! deassekeh pinchas.
Shemuel katav sifro. vehachtiv: "ushemuel met"! deassekeh gad hachoze venatan hannavi.

David katav sefer tehillim – al yede asara zekenim. velichshov name etan haezrachi! amar rav: etan haezrachi ze hu avraham – ketiv hacha: "etan haezrachi", uchetiv hatam: "mi heir mimmizrach tzedek [vegomer]".
Ka chashev moshe veka chashev heman, vehaamar rav: heman ze moshe – ketiv hacha: "heman", uchetiv hatam: "bechol beti neeman hu"! tere heman havo.

Moshe katav sifro ufarashat bilam veiyyov. mesayyeya leh lerabbi levi bar lachma – deamar rabbi levi bar lachma: iyyov bime moshe haya – ketiv hacha: "mi yitten efo veyikkatvun millay", uchetiv hatam: "uvamme yivvada efo".
Veema bime yitzchak, dichtiv: "mi efo hu hatztzad tzayid"! veema bime yaakov, dichtiv: "im ken efo zot asu"! veema bime yosef, dichtiv: "efo hem roim"!
La salka datach, dichtiv: "mi yitten bassefer veyuchaku" – umoshe hu deikkeri "mechokek", dichtiv: "vayyar reshit lo ki sham chelkat mechokek safun".

Rava amar: iyyov bime meraggelim haya – ketiv hacha: "ish haya veeretz utz, iyyov shemo", uchetiv hatam: "hayesh bah etz". mi dame?! hacha "utz", hatam "etz"! hachi kaamar lehu moshe leyisrael: yeshno leoto adam sheshshenotav arukkot keetz, umegen al doro keetz?
Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derabbi shemuel bar nachmani, veyatev vekaamar: iyyov lo haya velo nivra, ella mashal haya. amar leh: alecha amar kera: "ish haya veeretz utz, iyyov shemo".
Ella meatta, "velarash en kol ki im kivsa achat ketanna, asher kana vaychayyeha vegomer", mi hava? ella mashal bealma, hacha name mashal bealma. im ken, shemo veshem iro lamma?
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: iyyov meole gola haya, uvet midrasho bitverya haya. metivi: yeme shenotav shel iyyov – mishshaa shennichnesu yisrael lemitzrayim, vead sheyyatzu!
b: Ema: kemishshaa shennichnesu yisrael lemitzrayim, vead [shaa] sheyyatzu.

Metivi: shiva neviim nitnabbeu leummot haolam – veellu hen: bilam veaviv veiyyov, elifaz hattemani uvildad hashshuchi vetzofar hannaamati veelihu ven barachel habbuzi! amar leh: velitamaych, elihu ven barachel – lav miyyisrael hava? veha ketiv "mimmishpachat ram"!

Ella innabboye innabbi leummot haolam; hachi name iyyov – innabboye innabbi [leummot haolam]. attu kullehu nevie mi la innabbo leummot haolam? hatam – ikkar neviutayyhu leyisrael, hacha – ikkar neviutayyhu leummot haolam.

Metivi: chasid haya beummot haolam – veiyyov shemo, velo ba laolam ella kede lekabbel secharo. hevi hakkadosh baruch hu alav yissurin – hitchil mecharef umegaddef. kafal lo hakkadosh baruch hu secharo baolam hazze, [kede] letordo min haolam habba!

Tannae hi. detanya, rabbi elazar omer: iyyov bime shefot hashshoftim haya, shenneemar: "hen attem kullechem chazitem, velamma ze hevel tehbalu" – eze dor shekkullo hevel? heve omer: ze doro shel shefot hashshoftim.

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: iyyov bime achashverosh haya, shenneemar: "velo nimtza nashim yafot kivnot iyyov bechol haaretz" – ezehu dor shennitbakkeshu bo nashim yafot? heve omer: ze doro shel achashverosh. veema bime david, dichtiv: "vayvakshu naara yafa"! hatam bechol gevul yisrael, hacha bechol haaretz.

Rabbi natan omer: iyyov bime malchut sheva haya, shenneemar: "vattippol sheva vattikkachem". vachachamim omrim: iyyov bime kasdim haya, shenneemar: "kasdim samu shelosha rashim". veyesh omrim: iyyov bime yaakov haya, vedina bat yaakov nasa – ketiv hacha: "kedabber achat hannevalot tedabberi", uchetiv hatam: "ki nevala asa veyisrael". vechullehu tannae sevira lehu deiyyov miyyisrael hava, levar miyyesh omrim;

Dei salka datach meummot haolam hava, batar dishchev moshe – mi sharya shechina al ummot haolam? veha amar mar: bikkesh moshe shello tishre shechina al ummot haolam, venatan lo – shenneemar: "veniflinu ani veammecha".

Amar rabbi yochanan: doro shel iyyov shatuf bezimma haya, shenneemar: "hen attem kullechem chazitem, velamma ze hevel tehbalu", uchetiv: "shuvi shuvi hashshulammit shuvi shuvi venecheze bach". ema binvua, dichtiv: "chazon yeshayahu ven amotz"! im ken, "lamma ze hevel tehbalu" lema li?

Veamar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "vayhi bime shefot hashshoftim"? dor sheshshofet et shoftav; omer lo: "tol kesam mibben enecha" – omer lo: "tol kora mibben enecha". omer lo: "kaspecha haya lesigim" – omer lo: "sovacha mahul bemayim".
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haomer malkat sheva ishsha hayta – eno ella toe; may "malkat sheva"? malchuta dishva.

"Vayhi hayyom, vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai, vayyavo gam hassatan betocham. vayyomer Adonai el hassatan: meayin tavo? vayyaan hassatan vegomer" – amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, shatti bechol haolam kullo, velo matzati neeman keavdecha avraham – sheamarta lo: "kum hithallech baaretz leorkah ulerochbah ki lecha ettenenna", vaafillu hachi, beshaa shello matza makom likbor et sara [ad shekkana bearba meot shekel kesef] – lo hirher achar middotecha.

"Vayyomer Adonai el hassatan: hasamta libbecha el avdi iyyov, ki en kamohu baaretz vegomer" – amar rabbi yochanan: gadol hanneemar beiyyov yoter mimma shenneemar beavraham; deillu beavraham ketiv: "ki atta yadati ki yere elohim atta", uveiyyov ketiv: "ish tam veyashar yere elohim [vesar mera]".
May "vesar mera"? amar rabbi abba bar shemuel: iyyov vavtran bemamono haya – minhago shel olam, noten chatzi peruta lachenvani; iyyov – vitterah mishshello.

"Vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar: hachinnam yare iyyov elohim?! halo atta sachta vaado uvead beto vegomer" – may "maase yadav berachta"? amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: kol hannotel peruta meiyyov, mitbarech.
May "umiknehu paratz baaretz"? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: miknehu shel iyyov partzu gidro shel olam; minhago shel olam – zeevim horgim haizzim, miknehu shel iyyov – izzim horgim et hazzeevim.

"Veulam shelach na yadcha vega bechol asher lo, im lo al panecha yevarchekka. vayyomer Adonai el hassatan: hinne chol asher lo beyadecha, rak elav al tishlach yadecha vegomer. vayhi hayyom, uvanav uvenotav ochlim veshotim yayin bevet achihem habbechor, umalach ba el iyyov vayyomar: habbakar hayu chorshot vegomer" – may "habbakar hayu chorshot, vehaatonot root al yedehem"? amar rabbi yochanan: melammed shehitimo hakkadosh baruch hu leiyyov

a: Meen haolam habba.

"Od ze medabber – veze ba, vayyomar: esh elohim vegomer. od ze medabber – veze ba, vayyomar: kasdim samu shelosha rashim, vayyifshetu al haggemallim vayyikkachum vegomer. od ze medabber – veze ba, vayyomar: banecha uvenotecha ochlim veshotim yayin bevet achihem habbechor, vehinne ruach gedola baa meever hammidbar, vayyigga bearba pinnot habbayit vayyippol al hannearim vegomer. vayyakom iyyov vayyikra et meilo vayyagoz et rosho vegomer, vayyomer: arom yatzati mibbeten immi, vearom ashuv shamma; Adonai natan vaAdonai lakach, yehi shem Adonai mevorach. bechol zot lo chata iyyov velo natan tifla lelohim.

Vayhi hayyom, vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev vegomer. vayyomer Adonai el hassatan: e mizze tavo? vayyaan hassatan et Adonai, vayyomar: mishshut baaretz [vegomer]" – amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, shatti bechol haolam, velo matzati keavdecha avraham – sheamarta lo: "kum hithallech baaretz leorkah ulerochbah, ki lecha ettenenna", uveshaa shebbikkesh likbor sara, lo matza makom lekovrah – velo hirher achar middotecha.
"Vayyomer Adonai el hassatan: hasamta libbecha el avdi iyyov, ki en kamohu baaretz vegomer, veodennu machazik betummato, vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam" –
Amar rabbi yochanan: ilmale mikra katuv, i efshar leomro – keadam shemmesitin oto venisat.
Bematnita tana: yored umate, veole umargiz, notel reshut, venotel neshama.

"Vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar: or bead or, vechol asher laish yitten bead nafsho. ulam shelach na yadcha vega el atzmo veel besaro, im lo al panecha yevarchekka. vayyomer Adonai el hassatan: hinno veyadecha, ach et nafsho shemor. vayyetze hassatan meet pene Adonai, vayyach et iyyov vegomer". amar rabbi yitzchak: kashe tzaaro shel satan, yoter mishshel iyyov – mashal leeved sheamar lo rabbo: shevor chavit, ushemor et yenah.

Amar resh lakish: hu satan, hu yetzer hara, hu malach hammavet. hu satan – dichtiv: "vayyetze hassatan meet pene Adonai". hu yetzer hara – ketiv hatam: "rak ra kol hayyom", uchetiv hacha: ("rak et nafsho shemor") ["rak elav al tishlach yadecha"]. hu malach hammavet – dichtiv: "(rak) [ach] et nafsho shemor" – alma bedideh kayyma.

Amar rabbi levi: satan ufenina leshem shamayim nitkavvevnu. satan – kevan dechazye lehakkadosh baruch hu denatya dateh batar iyyov, amar: chas veshalom minneshe leh lerachmanuteh deavraham. penina – dichtiv: "vechiasatta tzaratah gam kaas, baavur hareimah". darsha rav acha bar yaakov befapponya. ata satan, nashshekeh lechareh.

"Bechol zot lo chata iyyov bisfatav". amar rava: bisfatav lo chata, belibbo chata. may kaamar? "eretz nittena veyad rasha, pene shofteha yechasse, im lo efo mi hu" – amar rava: bikkesh iyyov lahafoch keara al piha. amar leh abbaye: lo dibber iyyov ella keneged hassatan.
Ketannae: "eretz nittena veyad rasha" – rabbi eliezer omer: bikkesh iyyov lahafoch keara al piha. amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo dibber iyyov ella kelappe satan.

"Al datecha ki lo ersha veen miyyadcha matztzil" – amar rava: bikkesh iyyov liftor et kol haolam kullo min haddin. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, barata shor – parsotav sedukot, barata chamor – parsotav kelutot; barata gan eden, barata gehinnam; barata tzaddikim, barata reshaim. mi meakkev al yadcha?
Umay ahdaru leh chavreh [deiyyov] – "af atta tafer yira, vetigra sicha lifne el"; bara hakkadosh baruch hu yetzer hara – bara lo tora tavlin.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "birkat oved alay tavo, velev almana arnin"? "birkat oved alay tavo" – melammed shehaya gozel sade miyyetomim, umashbichah umachzirah lahen". "velev almana arnin" – dechol hecha dahava ikka almana dela havo nasvi la, hava azel shade shemeh illavav, vahavo atu nasvi la.

"Lu shakol yishshakel kasi vehavvati, bemoznayim yisu yachad" – amar rav: afra lefummeh deiyyov, chavruta kelappe shemayya! "lu yesh benenu mochiach, yashet yado al shenenu" – amar rav: afra lefummeh deiyyov, kelum yesh eved shemmochiach et rabbo?! "berit karatti leenay, uma etbonen al betula" – amar rava: afra lefummeh deiyyov, ihu – beachranyata, avraham – afillu bedideh la istakkal – dichtiv: "hinne na yadati ki ishsha yefat mare at" – mikkelal demeikkara la hava yada la.

"Kala anan vayyelach, ken yored sheol lo yaale" – amar rava: mikkan shekkafar iyyov bitchiyyayt hammetim. "asher bisara yeshufeni, vehirba fetzaay chinnam" – amar rabba: iyyov bisara cheraf, uvisara heshivuhu.

Bisara cheraf – dichtiv: "asher bisara yeshufeni"; amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, shemma ruach seara avra lefanecha, venitchallef lecha ben iyyov leoyev? bisara heshivuhu – dichtiv: vayyaan Adonai et iyyov min hasseara, vayyomar: [vegomer] ezor na chegever chalatzecha, eshalcha vehodieni.

Amar lo: harebe nimin barati beadam; vechol nima venima barati lah gumma bifne atzmah, shello yehu shetayim yonkot miggumma achat; sheilmale shetayim yonkot miggumma achat – machshichot meor enav shel adam. ben gumma legumma lo nitchallef li; ben iyyov leoyev nitchallef li?!

"Mi fillag lashshetef teala [vegomer]" – harebe tippin barati beavim, vechol tippa vetippa barati lah defus bifne atzmah, kede shello yehu shete tippin yotzot middefus echad; sheilmale shete tippin yotzot middefus echad – metashteshot et haaretz veenah motziah perot. ben tippa letippa lo nitchallef li; ben iyyov leoyev nitchallef li?! may mashma dehay teala lishshana didfus hi? amar rabba bar shela, dichtiv: "vayyaas teala kevet satayim zera".

"Vederech lachaziz kolot" – harebe kolot barati beavim, vechol kol vekol barati lo shevil bifne atzmo, keday shello yehu shete kolot yotzot mishshevil echad; sheilmale shete kolot yotzot mishshevil echad – macharivin et kol haolam. ben kol lekol lo nitchallef li, ben iyyov leoyev nitchallef li?!
"Hayadata et ledet yaale sala, cholel ayyalot tishmor" – yeela zo achzarit al baneha, beshaa shekkoraat
b: Laledet, ola lerosh hahar kede sheyyippol mimmenna veyamut; vaani mazmin lah nesher shemmekabbelo bichnafav umannicho lefaneha, veilmale makdim rega echad o mitacher rega echad – miyyad met. ben rega lerega lo nitchallef li, ben iyyov leoyev nitchallef li?!

"Cholel ayyalot tishmor" – ayyala zo rachmah tzar; beshaa shekkoraat laledet, ani mazmin lah derakon shemmakkishah bevet harechem, umitrappa mimmoladah; veilmale makdim rega echad o meacher rega echad miyyad meta. ben rega lerega lo nitchallef li, ben iyyov leoyev nitchallef li?!
"[Iyyov] lo vedaat yedabber, udevarav lo vehasekel"; uchetiv: "ki lo dibbartem elay nechona keavdi iyyov"! amar rava: mikkan sheen adam nitpas bishat tzaaro.

"Vayyishmeu sheloshet ree iyyov et kol haraa hazzot habbaa alav, vayyavou ish mimmekomo – elifaz hattemani uvildad hashshuchi vetzofar hannaamati, vayyivvaadu yachdav lavo lanud lo ulenachamo" – may "vayyivvaadu yachdav"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: melammed shennichnesu kullan beshaar echad. vetana: ben kol echad veechad shelosh meot parse.
Mena havo yadi? ikka deamri: kelila hava lehu. veikka deamri: ilane hava lehu, vechevan dechamshi havo yadi. amar rava: hayeynu deamri inashe: o chavra kechavre deiyyov, o mituta.

"Vayhi ki hechel haadam larov al pene haadama, uvanot yulledu lahem" – rabbi yochanan amar: reviyyay baa leolam. resh lakish amar: meriva baa laolam. amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: ledidach deamrat reviyyay baa leolam, mippene ma lo nichpelu benotav shel iyyov?

Amar lo: nehi delo nichpelu beshemot, aval nichpelu beyofi – dichtiv: "vayhi lo shivana vanim veshalosh banot, vayyikra shem haachat yemima, veshem hashshenit ketzia, veshem hashshelishit keren happuch".

Yamima – shehayta doma layyom. ketzia – shehaya rechah nodef kiktzia. keren happuch – amri deve rabbi shela: sheddoma lekarna dekeresh. mechayyeychu ala bemareva, karna dekeresh lakuta hi! ella amar rav chisda: kechurekma derishka bemineh – shenneemar: "ki tikrei bappuch".

Rabbi shimon berabbi ityelida leh beratta, hava ka chalash dateh. amar leh avu: reviyya baa laolam. amar leh bar kappara: tanchumin shel hevel nichemcha avuch – [detanya:] i efshar laolam belo zecharim uvelo nekevot; ella ashre lemi shebbanav zecharim, oy lo lemi shebbanav nekevot. i efshar laolam belo bassam uvelo buresi; ashre mi sheummanuto busemi, oy lemi sheummanuto buresi.

Ketannae: "vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol" – may "bakkol"? rabbi meir omer: shello hayta lo bat. rabbi yehuda omer: shehayta lo bat. acherim omrim: bat hayta lo leavraham, uvakkol" shemah. rabbi elazar hammodai omer: itztagninut hayta belibbo shel avraham avinu, shekkol malche mizrach umaarav mashkimin lefitcho. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: even tova hayta teluya betzavvaro shel avraham avinu, shekkol chole haroe oto miyyad mitrappe; uveshaa shenniftar avraham avinu min haolam – telaah hakkadosh baruch hu begalgal chamma. amar abbaye, hayeynu deamri inashe: iddalli yoma iddalli ketzira.

Davar acher: shello marad esav beyamav. davar acher: sheasa yishmael teshuva beyamav. shello marad esav beyamav – menalan? dichtiv: "vayyavo esav min hassade, vehu ayef", vetana: oto hayyom niftar avraham avinu, veasa yaakov avinu tavshil shel adashim lenachem et yitzchak aviv.

[Umay shena shel adashim?] amri bemareva mishshemeh derabba bar mari: ma adasha zo en lah pe, af avel en lo pe. davar acher: ma adasha zo megulegelet, af avelut megalgelet umechazzeret al bae haolam. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu lenachome bevee.
Amar rabbi yochanan: chamesh averot avar oto rasha beoto hayyom – ba al naara meorasa, veharag et hannefesh, vechafar baikkar, vechafar bitchiyyayt hammetim, veshat et habbechora.

Ba al naara meorasa – ketiv hacha: "vayyavo esav min hassade", uchetiv hatam: "ki vassade metzaah". harag et hannefesh – ketiv hacha: "ayef", uchetiv hatam: "oy na li ki ayfa nafshi lehorgim". vechafar baikkar – ketiv hacha: "lamma ze li", uchetiv hatam: "ze eli veanvehu". vechafar bitchiyyayt hammetim – dichtiv: "hinne anochi holech lamut". veshat et habbechora – dichtiv: "vayyivez esav et habbechora".

Vesheasa yishmael teshuva beyamav – menalan? ki ha deravina verav chama bar buzi havo yatvi kammeh derava, veka menamnem rava. amar leh ravina lerav chama bar buzi, vadday deamritu: kol mita sheyyesh bah "gevia" – zo hi mitatan shel tzaddikim? amar leh: in. veha dor hammabbul! amar leh: anan "gevia" vaasifa" kaamrinan.

Veha yishmael, dichtiv beh "gevia" vaasifa"! addehachi ittear behu rava, amar lehu: dardeke, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: yishmael asa teshuva bechayye aviv, shenneemar: "vayyikberu oto yitzchak veyishmael banav".

Vedilma derech chochmatan ka chashev lehu! ella meatta, "vayyikberu oto esav veyaakov banav", may tama la chashev lehu derech chochmatan? ella middeakdemeh – adbore adbereh, umiddeadbereh – shema minna teshuva avad beyamav.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha hitiman hakkadosh baruch hu baolam hazze

a: Meen haolam habba, ellu hen: avraham, yitzchak veyaakov. avraham – dichtiv beh: "bakkol". yitzchak – dichtiv beh: "mikkol". yaakov – dichtiv beh: "kol".

Shelosha lo shalat bahen yetzer hara, ellu hen: avraham, yitzchak veyaakov; dichtiv behu: "bakkol", "mikkol", "kol". veyesh omrim: af david, dichtiv: "velibbi chalal bekirbi". veiddach – tzaareh hu deka madkar.

Tanu rabbanan: shishsha lo shalat bahen malach hammavet, veellu hen: avraham, yitzchak veyaakov, moshe, aharon umiryam. avraham, yitzchak veyaakov – dichtiv behu: "bakkol", "mikkol", "kol"; moshe, aharon umiryam – dichtiv behu: "al pi Adonai".
Veha miryam la ketiv bah: "al pi Adonai"! amar rabbi elazar: miryam name binshika meta, deatya "sham"–"sham" mimmoshe. umippene ma lo neemar vah "al pi Adonai" – sheggenay haddavar lomar.

Tanu rabbanan: shiva lo shalat bahen rimma vetolea, veellu hen: avraham, yitzchak veyaakov, moshe, aharon umiryam, uvinyamin ben yaakov. avraham, yitzchak veyaakov – dichtiv [behu]: "bakkol", "mikkol", "kol". moshe, aharon umiryam – dichtiv [behu]: "al pi Adonai". binyamin ben yaakov – dichtiv: "ulevinyamin amar: yedid Adonai, yishkon lavetach alav". veyesh omrim: af david, dichtiv: "af besari yishkon lavetach". veiddach – hahu rachame hu deka bae.

Tanu rabbanan: arbaa metu beetyo shel nachash. veellu hen: binyamin ben yaakov, veamram avi moshe, veyishay avi david, vechilav ben david. vechullehu gemara, levar miyyishay avi david dimfarash beh [kera], dichtiv: "veet amasa sam avshalom tachat yoav al hatztzava, vaamasa ven ish ushemo yitra hayyisreeli, asher ba el avigayil bat nachash achot tzeruya em yoav" – vechi bat nachash hi? vahalo bat yishay hi, dichtiv: "veachyotehem tzeruya vaavigayil"! ella bat mi shemmet beetyo shel nachash.
Haderan alach hashshuttafin
Mishna lo yachpor adam bor samuch levoro shel chavero, velo shich, velo meara, velo ammat hammayim, velo nivrechet kovsin – ella im ken hirchik mikkotel chavero shelosha tefachim, vesad besid.

Umarchikim et haggefet, veet hazzevel, veet hammelach, veet hassid, veet hasselaim, mikkotlo shel chavero – shelosha tefachim; o sad besid. marchikin et hazzeraim, veet hammacharesha, veet me raglayim min hakkotel – shelosha tefachim.
Umarchikin et harechayim shelosha min hashshechev, shehen arbaa min harechev; veet hattannur – shelosha min hakkilya, shehen arbaa min hassafa.
b: Gemara patach bevor – umesayyem bechotel; litne: ella im ken hirchik mibboro shel chavero shelosha tefachim!
Amar abbaye, veittema rav yehuda: "mikkotel boro" shaninu.

Velitne: ella im ken hirchik mibboro shel chavero shelosha tefachim! ha ka mashma lan – dechotel bor shelosha tefachim; nafka minna lemikkach umimkar – kidtanya: haomer lachavero: "bor vechotleha ani mocher lach" – tzarich sheyyehe hakkotel shelosha tefachim.
Ittemar: habba lismoch betzad hammetzer – abbaye amar: somech, verava amar: eno somech. besade haasuya levorot – divre hakkol eno somech, ki peligi – besade sheenah asuya levorot.
Abbaye amar: somech – deha enah asuya levorot. rava amar: eno somech – deamar leh: ki hechi deat immelacht vachafart, ana name mimmelachna vechafarna.

Ikka deamri: besade sheenah asuya levorot – divre hakkol somech, ki peligi – besade haasuya levorot. abbaye amar: somech – afillu lerabbanan, deamri: marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma – hatam hu dividdana deka nata, ita levor; aval hacha, beiddana deka chafar – leta levor.

Verava amar: eno somech – vaafillu lerabbi yose deamar: ze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello – hane mille hatam, dividdana deka nata – letanhu leshorashav demazzeki la levor; aval hacha – amar leh: kol mara umara deka machayet, ka merappet la learay.

Tenan: lo yachpor adam bor samuch levoro shel chavero. tama deikka bor, ha lekka bor – somech; bishlama lehach lishshana deamrat: besade sheenah asuya levorot – divre hakkol somech, matnitin besade sheenah asuya levorot.
Ella lehach lishshana deamrat: besade sheenah asuya levorot peligi – bishlama leabbaye nicha, ella lerava kashya!
Amar lach rava: ha ittemar ala, amar abbaye veittema rav yehuda: mikkotel boro shaninu.

Ikka deamri: veittemar ala, amar abbaye veittema rav yehuda: mikkotel boro shaninu. bishlama lehach lishshana deamrat: besade haasuya levorot – divre hakkol eno somech, matnitin besade haasuya levorot.
Ella lehach lishshana deamrat: besade haasuya levorot peligi – bishlama lerava nicha, ella leabbaye kashya!
Amar lach abbaye: matnitin shebbau lachpor bevat achat.
Ta shema: sela habba beyadayim – ze chofer boro mikkan, veze chofer boro mikkan; ze marchik shelosha tefachim vesad besid, vaze marchik shelosha tefachim vesad besid! ba beyadayim shane.
Udekaare la may kaare la? ba beyadayim itztericha leh, salka datach amena: kevan deva beyadayim, live name ravvcha tefe; ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: marchikin et haggefet, veet hazzevel, veet

a: Hammelach, veet hassid, veet hasselaim mikkotlo shel chavero shelosha tefachim, o sad besid. tama deikka kotel, ha lekka kotel – somech!
La; ki lekka kotel name la samech. veella may ka mashma lan? ha ka mashma lan – dehane kashu lechotel.

Ta shema: marchikim et hazzeraim, veet hammacharesha, veet me raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim. tama deikka kotel, ha lekka kotel – samech! la; ki lekka kotel name la samech. veella may ka mashma lan? ha ka mashma lan – dimtuneta kashe lakkotel.

Ta shema: veet harechayim – shelosha min hashshechev shehen arbaa min harechev. tama deikka kotel, ha lekka kotel – samech! la; ki lekka kotel name la samech. veella may ka mashma lan? ha ka mashma lan – detiryay kashe lakkotel.

Ta shema: veet hattannur – shelosha min hakkilya shehen arbaa min hassafa. tama deikka kotel, ha lekka kotel – samech! la; ki lekka kotel name la samech. ella may ka mashma lan? ha ka mashma lan – dehavla kashe lakkotel.
Ta shema: lo yiftach adam chanut shel nachtomin veshel tzabbain tachat otzaro shel chavero, velo refet bakar. tama deikka otzar, ha lekka otzar – aved!
Dira shane. dayka name, detane ala: im hayta refet bakar kodemet laotzar – muttar.
Ta shema: lo yitta adam ilan samuch lassade, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot. vetane ala: arba ammot sheamru – kede avodat hakkerem.
Tama demishshum kede avodat hakkerem, ha lav mishshum kede avodat hakkerem – samech, veaf al gav deikka shorashin deka mazzeki! hacha bemay askinan – demafsek tzunema.
Dayka name, dekatane: haya gader benatayim – ze somech laggader mikkan, veze somech laggader mikkan.

I hachi, ema sefa: hayu shorashav yotzin betoch shel chavero – maamik lahen shelosha tefachim, kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha. vei demafsek tzunema, may bau hatam? hachi kaamar: vei lav tzunema, vehayu shorashav yotzin letoch shel chavero – maamik shelosha tefachim, kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha.

Ta shema: marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma. tama deikka bor, ha lekka bor – samech! la; ki lekka bor name la samech, veha kamashma lan – dead esrim vechamesh amma, azli shorashim umazzeki levor.
I hachi, ema sefa: veim ilan kadam – lo yakotz. vei dela samech, hechi mashkachat la? kidamar rav pappa: belokeach; hachi name belokeach.

Ta shema: marchikin et hammishra min hayyarak, veet hakkereshin min habbetzalin, veet hachardal min haddevorim. tama deikka yarak, ha lekka yarak – samech! la; ki lekka yarak name la samech; veha ka mashma lan – dehane kashu ahadade.

I hachi, ema sefa: rabbi yose mattir bechardal, mippene sheyyachol lomar lo: ad sheatta omer li harechek chardalecha min devoray, harechek devorecha min chardalay – shebbaot veochlot liglugay chardalay.
b: Vei dela samech, hechi mashkachat la? amar rav pappa: belokeach.
I belokeach, may tama derabbanan? veod, may tama derabbi yose? afillu mishra veyarka name!
Amar ravina: ka savri rabbanan: al hammazzik leharechik et atzmo.
Mikkelal derabbi yose savar: al hannizzak leharechik et atzmo?! i al hannizzak, afillu mishra veyarka name!

Ella leolam rabbi yose name al hammazzik sevira leh, vehachi kaamar lehu rabbi yose lerabbanan: tinach mishra veyarka – dehane mazzeki hane, vehane la mazzeki hane, ella chardal udevorim – tarvayyhu mazzeki ahadade!
Verabbanan – devorim lechardal la mazzeki leh; i bevinta – la mashkecha leh, i betarpa – hadar pare.

Vesavar rabbi yose al hammazzik leharechik et atzmo?! vehatnan, rabbi yose omer: af al pi shehabbor kodemet leilan – lo yakotz, shezze chofer betoch shello, veze notea betoch shello! ella leolam rabbi yose – al hannizzak sevira leh, uledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu:

Ledidi, al hannizzak leharechik et atzmo, vaafillu mishra veyarka la bae rachoke; ella ledidchu, deamritu al hammazzik; tinach mishra veyarka – dehane mazzeki hane, vehane la mazzeki hane, ella chardal udevorim – tarvayyhu mazzeki ahadade!
Verabbanan – devorim lechardal la mazzeki leh; i bevinta –

a: La mashkachat leh, i betarpa – hadar pare.

Velo nivrechet hakkovsin vechulei. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella min hammachmetzan, aval min hannadyayn – arba ammot. tanya name hachi: nivrechet hakkovsin – arba ammot. veha anan tenan shelosha tefachim! ella lav – shema minna kidrav nachman.
