Veikka derame lehu mirme, tenan: nivrechet hakkovsin shelosha tefachim. vehatanya arba ammot! amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, la kashya: kan min hammachmetzan, kan min hannadyayn. rav chiyyay bereh derav avya matne la behedya: ella im ken hirchik missefat machmetzan velakkotel shelosha tefachim.
Vesad besid. ibbaya lehu: "vesad besid" tenan, o dilma "o sad besid" tenan?
Peshita divsad besid" tenan, dei salka datach deo sad besid" tenan, im ken liarvinhu velitninhu!
Dilma mishshum dela dame hay hezzeka lehay hezzeka – resha hezzeka dimtuna, sefa hezzeka dehavla.

Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: sela habba beyadayim – ze chofer boro mikkan, veze chofer boro mikkan; ze marchik shelosha tefachim vesad besid, vaze marchik shelosha tefachim vesad besid. tama deva beyadayim, ha lo ba beyadayim – lo!
Hu haddin deaf al gav delo ba beyadayim name sad besid, uva beyadayim itztericha leh – salka datach amena: kevan deva beyadayim, live ravvcha tefe; ka mashma lan:.
Marchikin et haggefet veet hazzevel veet hammelach veet hasselaim vechulei. tenan hatam: bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin?

En tomnin lo baggefet, velo bazzevel, velo bammelach, velo bassid, velo bachol – ben lachin ben yeveshin. may shena hacha dekatane selaim vela katane chol, umay shena hatam dekatane chol vela katane selaim?

Amar rav yosef: lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lehatemin bislaim. amar leh abbaye: vechi darkan shel bene adam lehatemin begizze tzemer uleshonot shel argaman?! detanya: tomnin begizze tzemer, uvetzippe tzemer, uvilshonot shel argaman, uvemochin, veen metaltelin otan!

Ella amar abbaye: "yaggid alav reo"; tena hacha selaim – vehu haddin lechol, tena hatam chol – vehu haddin lislaim. amar leh rava: i "yaggid alav reo", litninhu lechullehu bachada, velitne chada minnayyhu beiddach – vehu haddin leiddach!
Ella amar rava: hatam hayeynu tama dela katane selaim – mishshum dimshattechi la likdera; hacha hayeynu tama dela katane chol – mishshum demechammime chayem umikkarire karer.
Veha tane rabbi oshaya: chol! hatam bimtuna. tanna didan name litne, velokmeh bimtuna! ha tena leh ammat hammayim.
Attu mi la katane ammat hammayim – vekatane nivrechet hakkovsin?
Hanhu tzerichi; dei tena ammat hammayim – mishshum dikvia, aval nivrechet hakkovsin, dela kevia – ema la. vei tena nivrechet hakkovsin – mishshum dikvu vekayymi, aval ammat hammayim – la; tzericha.
Marchikin et hazzeraim veet hammacharesha vechulei. zeraim – tippok leh mishshum macharesha! bemappolet yad.
Macharesha – vetippok leh mishshum zeraim! bechoresh leilanot. vetippok leh mishshum mayya! tanna beeretz yisrael kae, dichtiv: "limtar hashshamayim tishte mayim".
Lememra dizraim
b: Litzdadin ka mishtarshi?! veha tenan: hammavrich et haggefen baaretz, im en al gabbah afar shelosha tefachim – lo yavi zera aleha;
Vetane ala: aval zorea et hatztzedadin elach veelach. amar rabbi chagga beshem rabbi yose: mippene shemmachalidin et hakkarka umaalin afar tichuach.

Veet me raglayim min hakkotel – shelosha tefachim vechulei. amar rabba bar bar chana: muttar laadam lehashetin mayim betzad kotlo shel chavero, dichtiv: "vehichratti leachav mashtin bekir, veatzur veazuv beyisrael". veha anan tenan: veet me raglayim min hakkotel – shelosha tefachim! hatam beshofchin.
Ta shema: lo yishpoch adam mayim betzad kotlo shel chavero – ella im ken hirchik mimmennu shelosha tefachim! hatam name beshofchin.

Ta shema: lo yashtin adam mayim betzad kotlo shel chavero – ella im ken hirchik mimmennu shelosha tefachim. bamme devarim amurim – bechotel levenim, aval bechotel avanim – bichde shello yazzik. vechamma? tefach. veshel tzunema – muttar. teyuveta derabba bar bar chana, teyuveta.
Veha rabba bar bar chana – kera kaamar! hatam hachi kaamar: afillu midde dedarkeh leayshtone bekir la shavekna leh, umay nihu? kalba.
Amar rabbi tovi bar kisna amar shemuel: rakik eno memaet bachallon. may irya rakik? afillu ave name!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya ave – kevan deichazi leh, la mevattel leh; aval rakik, demimmeis – ema battole mevattel leh; ka mashma lan.
Vetippok leh dehave leh davar shehu mekabbel tumea, vechol davar shehu mekabbel tumea – eno chotzetz bifne hattumea! shennilosh beme ferot.

Metivi: kuppa melea teven, vechavit melea gerogrot, hammunnachim bachallon – roin, kol sheillu yinnatlu vicholin teven ugerogrot laamod bifne atzman – chotztzin, veim lav – en chotztzin. veha teven chaze livhemto!
Besarya. chaze letina! deit beh kotze. chaze lehassaka! bimtuna. chaze lehessek gadol! hessek gadol la shechiach.
Gerogrot – ha chazu leh! amar shemuel: beshehitrifu. vechen tane rabba bar avu: beshehitrifu.
Hay chavit, hechi damya? i defumma levar –

a: Hi gufa techutz, deha keli cheres eno mittamme miggabbo! ella defumma legav. vei baet ema: leolam defumma levar, hacha bemay askinan – bechavit shel mattechet.

Metivi: asavin shettelashan vehinnichan bachallon, o shealu mealehen bachallonot; umatloniyyot sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh; vehaever vehabbasar hameduledalin bivhema uvechayya; veof sheshshachan bachallon, vegoy sheyyashav bachallon, uven shemone hammunnach bachallon; vehammelach, ucheli cheres, vesefer tora – kullam memaatin bachallon. aval hashsheleg, vehabbarad, vehaggelid, vehakkefor, vehammayim – kullan en memaatin bachallon.
Veha asavin chazu livhemto! beafrazta.
O shealu mealehen. kevan dekashu lechotel – shakel lehu! amar rabba: bechotel chureba. rav pappa amar: afillu bechotel yishshuv – bevain chutz lishlosha lachallon.
Matloniyyot – chazu leh likria dilvusha! bismichta. chazu leummana! berissakka.
I berissakka, "sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh"?! "sheen bahen arbaa al arbaa" mibbee leh! keen rissakka.
Vehaever vehabbasar hameduledalin bivhema uvechayya – arka veazla! bikshura.
Shachet la! bitmea. mezabben la legoy! bichchusha. pasek, shade la lichlavim! kevan deikka tzaar baale chayyim, la aved.
Veof sheshshachan bachallon. parach veazel! bekashur. shachet leh! betame. mezabben leh legoy! biklanita.
Yahev leh leyanoka! bimsaret. kelanita la mesarta! keen kelanita.
Vegoy sheyyashav bachallon. kae veazel! bechafut. ate chavreh, share leh! bimtzora. ate metzora chavreh, share leh! ella bachavushe malchut.
Uven shemone hammunnach bachallon. atya immeh, darya leh! beshabbat; detanya: ben shemone hare hu keeven, veasur letaltelo beshabbat. aval immo shocha alav umenikato, mippene hassakkana.
Melach – chazya leh! bimrirta. chazya leorot! deit ba kotze.
Kevan dekashya lechotel, shakla! deyatva achaspa. chaspa gufa techutz!
b: Delet ba shiura; keditnan: cheres – kede litten ben patztzim lachavero.
Keli cheres – chaze leh! demittannaf. chaze leummana! dimnakkav.
Sefer tora – chaze lemikra! bevaluy. veha bae geniza! sham tehe genizatah.
Veamar rav: bakkol osin mechitza, chutz mimmelach urevav. ushemuel amar: afillu melach. amar rav pappa: vela peligi – ha bemelach sedomit, ha bemelach isterokanit.

Vehasheta deamar rabba: ose adam shene tzibbure melach umanniach alehem kora, shehammelach maamedet et hakkora vehakkora maamedet et hammelach; afillu melach isterokanit – vela peligi: ha deikka kora, ha delekka kora.

Marchikin et harechayim shelosha min hashshechev, shehen arbaa min harechev vechulei. may tama? mishshum tirya. veha tanya: veshel chamor – shelosha min haisterovel shehen arbaa min hakkelet; hatam may tirya ikka? ella mishshum kala.
Veet hattannur – shelosha min hakkilya, shehen arbaa min hassafa. amar abbaye: shema minna, kilya detannur tefach; nafka minna lemikkach umimkar.
Mishna lo yaamid adam tannur betoch habbayit, ella im ken yesh al gabbav gova arba ammot. haya maamido baaliyyay – tzarich sheyyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim. uvakkira – tefach.
Veim hizzik – meshallem ma shehizzik. rabbi shimon omer: lo amru kol hashshiurin haellu, ella sheim hizzik – patur milleshallem.
Lo yiftach adam chanut shel nachtomin veshel tzabbain tachat otzaro shel chavero, velo refet bakar. beemet bayyayin hittiru, aval lo refet bakar.
Gemara vehatanya: battannur arbaa, uvakkira shelosha! amar abbaye: ki tanya hahi – bidnachtomin, detannur didan ki kira denachtomin.
Lo yiftach chanut vechulei. tana: im hayta refet kodemet laotzar – muttar. bae abbaye: kibbed veribbetz leotzar, mahu?
Ribba bachallonot, mahu? achsadra tachat haotzar, mahu? bana aliyyay al gabbe beto, mahu? teku. bae rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: tamre verimmone, may? teku.

Beemet beyayin hittiru vechulei. tana: beyayin hittiru – mippene shemmashbicho, velo refet bakar – mippene shemmasricho. amar rav yosef: hay didan, afillu kutera dishraga name kashya leh. amar rav sheshet: veaspasta kerefet bakar damya.

Mishna chanut shebbechatzer – yachol limchot beyado velomar lo: eni yachol lishan mikkol hannichnasin umikkol hayyotzin. aval ose kelim – yotze umocher betoch hashshuk, veeno yachol limchot beyado velomar lo: eni yachol lishan – lo mikkol happattish, velo mikkol harechayim, velo mikkol hattinokot.
Gemara may shena resha, umay shena sefa? amar abbaye: sefa atan lechatzer acheret. amar leh rava: i hachi, litne: chatzer acheret – muttar! ella amar rava:

a: Sefa atan letinokot shel bet rabban, umittakkanat yehoshua ben gamla veelach –

Deamar rav yehuda amar rav: beram, zachur oto haish lattov – vihoshua ben gamla shemo, sheilmale hu, nishtakkach tora miyyisrael. shebbitchilla, mi sheyyesh lo av – melammedo tora, mi sheen lo av – lo haya lamed tora. may derush? "velimmadtem otam" – velimmadtem attem.

Hitkinu sheyyehu moshivin melammede tinokot birushalayim. may derush? "ki mitztziyyon tetze tora". vaadayin mi sheyyesh lo av – haya maalo umelammedo, mi sheen lo av – lo haya ole velamed. hitkinu sheyyehu moshivin bechol pelech ufelech. umachnisin otan keven shesh esre keven sheva esre,

Umi shehaya rabbo koes alav – mevaet bo veyotze. ad shebba yehoshua ben gamla vetikken, sheyyehu moshivin melammede tinokot bechol medina umedina uvechol ir vair, umachnisin otan keven shesh keven sheva.

Amar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat: ad shet la tekabbel, mikkan veelach – kabbel, veaspi leh ketora. vaamar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat: ki machet leyanoka, la timche ella bearketa dimsana. dekare – kare, dela kare – leheve tzavvta lechavreh.
Metivi: echad mibbene chatzer shebbikkesh leasot rofe, umman, vegardi, umelammed tinokot – bene chatzer meakkevin alav! hacha bemay askinan – betinokot degoyim.
Ta shema: shenayim sheyyoshvin bechatzer, uvikkesh echad mehen leasot rofe, veumman, vegardi, umelammed tinokot – chavero meakkev alav! hacha name betinokot degoyim.
Ta shema: mi sheyyesh lo bayit bachatzar hashshuttafin – hare ze lo yaskirennu lo lerofe, velo leumman, velo legardi, velo lesofer yehudi, velo lesofer armay! hacha bemay askinan – besofer mata.

Amar rava: mittakkanat yehoshua ben gamla veelach, la mamtinan yanoka mimmata lemata; aval mibbe chenishta leve chenishta – mamtinan. vei mafsek nahara – la mamtinan. vei ikka tittura – mamtinan. vei ikka gamla – la mamtinan.
Veamar rava: sach makre dardeke – esrin vechamsha yanoke. vei ikka chamshin – motvinan tere; vei ikka arbein – mokminan resh duchena, umesayyeyin leh mimmata.

Veamar rava: hay makre yanoke degares, veikka acharina degares tefe minneh – la mesallekinan leh, dilma ate leitrashshole. rav dimi minnehardea amar: kol shekken degares tefe – kinat sofrim tarbe chachma.

Veamar rava: hane tere makre dardeke – chad gares vela dayek, vechad dayek vela gares – motvinan hahu degares vela dayek; shabbeshta mimmela nafka. rav dimi minnehardea amar: motvinan dedayek vela gares; shabbeshta, kevan deal – al;
Dichtiv: "ki sheshet chodashim yashav sham yoav vechol yisrael, ad hichrit kol zachar beedom". ki ata lekammeh dedavid, amar leh:
b: May tama avadt hachi? amar leh, dichtiv: "timche et zechar amalek". amar leh: veha anan "zecher" karenan! amar leh: ana "zechar" akreyun. azal shayyleh lerabbeh, amar leh: heach akritan? amar leh: "zecher".

Shekal safsira lemikteleh. amar leh: ammay? amar leh, dichtiv: "arur ose melechet Adonai remiyya". amar leh: shivkeh lehahu gavra delekum bearur! amar leh, ketiv: "vearur monea charbo middam"! ikka deamri: katleh, veikka deamri: la katleh.
Veamar rava: makre yanoka, shattala, tabbacha, veummana, vesofer mata – kullan kemuterin veomdin ninhu. kelala demilleta: kol peseda dela hadar – mutere veomed hu.
Amar rav huna: hay bar mevoa deoki richya, vaata bar mevoa chavreh vekamoke gabbeh – dina hu dimakkev illaveh. deamar leh: ka paskat leh lechayyuti.
Lema mesayyay leh: marchikim metzudat haddag min haddag – kimlo ritzat haddag. vechamma? amar rabba bar rav huna: ad parsa. shane dagim, deyahavi seyayra.
Amar leh ravina lerava: lema rav huna deamar kerabbi yehuda – ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: lo yechallek chenvani kelayot veegozin letinokot, mippene shemmergilan etzlo. vachachamim mattirin.

Afillu tema rabbanan; ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda hatam – ella daamar leh: ana kamfallegyna amgoze, at pelog sheyuseke. aval hacha – afillu rabbanan modu, daamar leh: ka paskat leh lechayyuti.

Metivi: ose adam chanut betzad chanuto shel chavero, umerchatz betzad merchatzo shel chavero; veeno yachol limchot beyado, mippene sheyyachol lomar lo: atta ose betoch shellecha, vaani ose betoch shelli!

Tannae hi, detanya: kofin bene mevoot ze et ze – shello lehoshiv benehen lo chayyayt, velo bureski, velo melammed tinokot, velo echad mibbene baale ummaniyyot; velishcheno eno kofehu. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af lishcheno kofehu.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: peshita li – bar mata abbar mata achariti, matze meakkev. vei shayech bichraga dehacha, la matze meakkev. bar mevoa abbar mevoa denafsheh – la matze meakkev.

Bae rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: bar mevoa abbar mevoa acharina, may? teku. amar rav yosef: umode rav huna bemakre dardeke – dela matze meakkev, deamar mar: ezra tikken lahen leyisrael sheyyehu moshivin sofer betzad sofer.
Venechush dilma ate leitrashshole! amar leh:

a: Kinat sofrim tarbe chachma.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: umode rav huna bereh derav yehoshua berochlin hammachazirin baayayrot, dela matze meakkev; deamar mar: ezra tikken lahen leyisrael sheyyehu rochlin machazirin baayayrot, kede sheyyehu tachshitin metzuyin livnot yisrael.

Vehane mille leahdore, aval leikkevoe – la. vei tzureba merabbanan hu, afillu leikkevoe name. ki ha derava shera lehu lerabbi yoshiyya ulerav ovadya leikkevoe – dela kehilcheta. may tama? kevan derabbanan ninhu, atu littardu miggirsayyhu.

Hanhu dikkulae deayyto diklae levavel. ato bene mata ka meakkevi illavayhu. ato lekammeh deravina, amar lehu: mealma atu, ulealma lizabbenu. vehane mille beyoma deshuka, aval bela yoma deshuka – la. uveyoma deshuka name la amrinan ella lezabbone beshuka, aval leahdore – la.

Hanhu amorae deayyto amra lefum nahara. ato bene mata ka meakkevi illavayhu. ato lekammeh derav kahana, amar lehu: dina hu dimakkevi alayychu. amaru leh: it lan ashray! amar lehu: zilu zabbenu shiur chayyutayychu ad deakritu ashray didchu, veazlitu.
Rav dimi minnehardea ayyti gerogrot bisfina. amar leh resh galuta lerava: pok chazi, i tzureba merabbanan hu – nakket leh shuka. amar leh rava lerav adda bar abba: pok tehi leh bekankanneh.

Nefak [azal] bea minneh: pil shebbela kefifa mitzrit, vehekiah derech bet hari, mahu? la hava bideh. amar leh: mar nihu rava? tefach leh besandaleh, amar leh: ben didi lerava ikka tuva, mihu al korchach ana rabbach, verava rabba derabbach.

La nakkitu leh shuka, pesud gerogrot dideh. ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: chazi mar may avadu li! amar leh: man dela shahayay leonita demalka deedom, la neshahayay leonitaych. dichtiv: "ko amar Adonai: al shelosha pishe moav veal arbaa lo ashivennu, al sorfo atzmot melech edom lassid".

Nach nafsheh derav adda bar abba. rav yosef amar: ana aneshteh – daana latyiteh. rav dimi minnehardea amar: ana aneshteh, deafsed gerogrot didi. abbaye amar: ana aneshteh, daamar lehu lerabbanan: addimgarmitu garme be abbaye, tu ichlu bisra [shammina] be rava. verava amar: ana aneshteh, [dechi hava azel leve tabbacha lemishkal umetza,] amar lehu letabbache: ana shakelna bisra mikkamme shammaeh derava, daana adifna minneh.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: ana aneshteh – derav nachman bar yitzchak resh kalla hava. kol yoma mikkamme deneul lechalla, marhet bahadeh rav adda bar abba lishmateh, vahadar ayel lechalla.

Hahu yoma naktu rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav adda bar abba mishshum dela havo besiyyuma, amaru leh: ema lan hane shematata demasar behema hechi amrinhu rava. amar lehu: hachi amar rava, vehachi amar rava. addehachi nega leh [lerav nachman bar yitzchak], vela ate rav adda bar abba;

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav nachman bar yitzchak: kum, dinga lan, lema yatev mar? amar lehu: yatevna veka menattera learseh derav adda bar abba. addehachi nefak kala denach nafsheh derav adda bar abba. umistabbera, derav nachman bar yitzchak ansheh.
Mishna mi shehaya kotlo samuch lechotel chavero, lo yismoch lo kotel acher, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot. hachallonot – ben millemalan, ben millemattan, ben kenegdan – arba ammot.
Gemara vekamma hechi samech? amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar:
b: Habba lismoch, lo yismoch ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot. matkef la rava: veha "mi shehaya kotlo samuch lechotel chavero" katane!

Ella amar rava, hachi katane: mi shehaya kotlo samuch lechotel chavero berachok arba ammot, venafal, lo yismoch lo kotel acher – ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot. may tama? dedavvsha dehacha mealle lehatam.
Amar rav: lo shanu ella kotel gina, aval kotel chatzer – im ba lismoch, somech. rabbi oshaya omer: echad kotel ginna veechad kotel chatzer – im ba lismoch, eno somech.
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: vela peligi – ha beir yeshana, ha beir chadasha.
Tenan: hachallonot, ben millemalan ben millemattan ben mikkenegdan – arba ammot. vetane ala: millemalan – kede shello yatzitz veyire, millemattan – shello yaamod veyire, umikkenegdan – shello yaafil.
Tama shello yaafil, aval mishshum davvsha la! hacha bemay askinan – beva min hatztzad.
Vechamma? amar yeva, chamu deashyayn bar nidbach, mishshemeh derav: kimlo rochav challon. vahalo metzitz! amar rav zevid: bemaddir et kotlo.
Veha anan tenan: arba ammot! la kashya: kan meruach achat, kan mishte ruchot.

Ta shema: veet hakkotel min hammazchela arba ammot, kede sheyyehe zokef et hassullam. tama mishshum sullam, aval mishshum davvsha la! hacha bemay askinan – bemazchela meshuppaat, dei mishshum davvsha hu – ha ka azel veate tuteh.
Mishna marchikin et hassullam min hashshovach arba ammot, kede shello tikpotz hannemiyyay. veet hakkotel min hammazchela arba ammot, kede sheyyehe zokef et hassullam.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi yose? dei rabbi yose, ha amar: ze chofer betoch shello, veze notea betoch shello!

Afillu tema rabbi yose, ha amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, hava amar: mode rabbi yose begire dideh; hacha name, zimnin devahade demannach leh – yatva bechor vekaftza. veha gerama hu! amar rav tovi bar matna, zot omeret: gerama benizzakin asur.
Rav yosef hava leh hanhu tale, dahavo

a: Atu ummane veyatvi tutayyhu, veatu orve achli dema, vesalki abbe tale umafsedi tamre. amar lehu rav yosef: appiku li kurekur mehacha. amar leh abbaye: veha gerama hu! amar leh: hachi amar rav tovi bar matna, zot omeret: gerama benizzakin asur.

Veha achzek [lehu]! ha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: en chazaka linzakin. velav ittemar ala – rav mari amar: bekutera, verav zevid amar: bevet hakkisse?! amar leh: hane, ledidi – daanina datay, ki kutera uvet hakkisse damu li.

Mishna marchikin et hashshovach min hair chamishshim amma. velo yaase adam shovach betoch shello, ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach. rabbi yehuda omer: bet arbaat korin – melo sheger hayyone. veim lekacho – afillu bet rova, hare hu bechezkato.
Gemara chamishshim amma – vetu la? ureminhi: en porsin nishbin leyonim, ella im ken haya rachok min hayyishshuv sheloshim ris!
Amar abbaye: meshat shayyti tuva, ucheresayyhu bachamishshim ammeta malya. umeshat – sheloshim ris vetu la? vehatanya: uvayyishshuv – afillu mea mil lo yifros! rav yosef amar: beyishshuv keramim.
Rava amar: beyishshuv shovachin. vetippok leh mishshum shovachin gufayyhu! ibbaet ema: dideh, veibbaet ema: degoy, veibbaet ema: dehefker.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bet arbaat korin vechulei. amar rav pappa, veittema rav zevid: zot omeret, toanin lelokeach vetoanin leyoresh.
Yoresh – tenena: habba mishshum yerushsha – eno tzarich taana! lokeach itztericha leh. lokeach name tenena: lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugezuzetraot – hare ze bechezkatah!
Tzericha; dei ashmeinan hatam gabbe reshut harabbim – deemor kones letoch shello hu, i name achole achul bene reshut harabbim gabbeh; aval hacha – la;
Vei ashmeinan hacha, dechevan deyachid hu – ema: payyose payyeyseh, i name achole achel gabbeh; aval rabbim, man payyes uman shavek – ema la; tzericha.
Hare hu bechezkato. veha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: en chazaka linzakin! rav mari amar: bekutera, rav zevid amar: bevet hakkisse.
b: Mishna nippul hannimtza betoch chamishshim amma – hare hu shel baal hashshovach. chutz mechamishshim amma – hare hu shel motzo. nimtza ben shene shovachot; karov laze – shello. karov laze – shello. mechetza al mechetza – shenehem yachloku.
Gemara amar rabbi chanina: rov vekarov – holchin achar harov; veaf al gav derubba deorayyta vekureva deorayyta – afillu hachi, rubba adif.
Metiv rabbi zera: "vehaya hair hakkerova el hechalal" – veaf al gav deikka achariti dinfisha minna!
Bidlekka. velezil batar rubba dealma! beyoshevet ben heharim.
Tenan: nippul hannimtza betoch chamishshim amma – hare hu shel baal hashshovach; veaf al gav deikka acharina dinfish minneh! bidlekka.

I hachi, ema sefa: chutz mechamishshim amma – hare hu shel motzo. vei delekka, vadday mehahu nefal! hacha bemay askinan – bimdadde, deamar rav ukeva bar chama: kol hamedadde – en medadde yoter mechamishshim.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: raglo achat betoch chamishshim amma, veraglo achat chutz mechamishshim amma – mahu? veal da appekuhu lerabbi yirmeya mibbe midresha.

Ta shema: nimtza ben shene shovachot; karov laze – shello, vekarov laze – shello; veaf al gav dechad minnayyhu nefish mechavreh! hacha bemay askinan – sheshshenehen shavin. velezil batar rubba dealma! hacha bemay askinan –

a: Bishvil shel keramim; deim ita demealma ate, kevan demiddadde – la matze ate; dechol demiddadde vahadar chaze leh lekinneh – middadde, vei la – la middadde.
Amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: dam shennimtza bapperozdor – sefeko tame, shechezkato min hammakor. veaf al gav deikka aliyyay, dimkarva!
Amar leh rava: rov umatzuy ka amrat? rov umatzuy lekka leman deamar.
Detane rabbi chiyyay: dam hannimtza bapperozdor, chayyayvin alav al biat mikdash, vesorfin alav et hatteruma.
Veamar rava, shema minna midderabbi chiyyay – telat: shema minna rov vekarov hallech achar harov, ushema minna rubba deorayyta, ushema minna ita lidrabbi zera –
Deamar rabbi zera: af al pi sheddaltot medina neulot.
Deha ishsha – dechi daltot medina neulot damya, vaafillu hachi ka azlinan batar rubba.
Veha rava hu dekaamar: rov umatzuy lekka leman deamar! hadar beh rava mehahi.

Ittemar: chavit shetztzafa bannahar, amar rav: nimtzet keneged ir sherubbah yisrael – muttar, keneged ir sherubbah nochrim – asira. ushemuel amar: afillu nimtzet keneged ir sherubbah yisrael – asira; emor mehay dekira atay.
Lema bidrabbi chanina ka mippalgi, demar it leh derabbi chanina, umar let leh derabbi chanina?
La; dechulle alma it lehu derabbi chanina, vehacha beha kamippalgi – demar savar: im ita demehay dekira atay, ikkule ufashore hava matbei la. umar savar: charifa denahara nekat vaatay.
Hahu chatzba dechamra deishtechach befardesa deorla, sharye ravina. lema mishshum desavar la derabbi chanina?
Shane hatam, dei miggeniv minne – atznoe begavveh la matznei. vehane mille chamra, aval inve – matznei.
Hanhu zike dechamra deishtechachu be kufae, sheranhu rava. lema la savar la lidrabbi chanina? shane hatam, derubba
b: Deshafochae – yisrael ninhu. vehane mille beravreve, aval zutere – emor meovre derachim neful. vei ikka ravreve bahadayyhu – emor baavarvare hava mannechi.

Mishna marchikin et hailan min hair esrim vechamesh amma, uvecharuv uvashshikma – chamishshim amma. abba shaul omer: kol ilan serak chamishshim amma. veim hair kadma – kotzetz, veeno noten damim; veim ilan kadam – kotzetz, venoten damim; safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam – kotzetz, veeno noten damim.
Gemara may tama? amar ulla: mishshum noye hair. vetippok leh deen osin sade migrash, velo migrash sade!
La tzericha – lerabbi elazar deamar: osin sade migrash umigrash sade, hacha mishshum noye hair la avdinan.
Ulerabbanan name, deamri: en osin sade migrash velo migrash sade – hane mille zeraim, aval ilanot avdinan; vehacha mishshum noye hair – la.
Umena temra deshane ben zerain leilanot? detanya: karpef yoter mibbet satayim shehukkaf ledira;
Nizra rubbo – hare hu keginna, veasur; nitta rubbo – hare hu kechatzer, umuttar.
Veim hair kadma – kotzetz veeno noten damim vechulei. may shena gabbe bor, dekatane – kotzetz venoten damim; umay shena hacha, dekatane: kotzetz veeno noten damim?
Amar rav kahana: kidra deve shuttafe – la chammima vela karira.
Umay kusheya? dilma shane hezzeka derabbim mehezzeka deyachid!

Ella i ittemar derav kahana, assefa ittemar – im hailan kadam, kotzetz venoten damim. velema lehu: havu li beresha deme, vahadar ikkotz! amar rav kahana: kidra deve shuttafe – la chammima vela karira.
Safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam – kotzetz veeno noten damim. may shena mibbor, deamrat: lo yakotz?
Hatam – devadday lav lemikkatz kae, sefeko name la amrinan leh "kotz"; hacha – devadday lemikkatz kae, sefeko name amrinan leh "kotz". vei mishshum deme – amrinan leh: ayyti reaya ushekol.

Mishna marchikin et goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma. lo yaase adam goren kavua betoch shello, ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach; umarchik minnetiotav shel chavero uminniro, bichde shello yazzik.
Gemara may shena resha, umay shena sefa? amar abbaye: sefa atan legoren sheeno kavua.
Hechi dame goren sheeno kavua? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kol sheeno zore berachat.
Rav ashe amar: ma taam kaamar – may tama marchikin goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma? kede shello yazzik.

Metivi: marchikin goren kavua min hair, chamishshim amma. ucheshem shemmarchikin min hair chamishshim amma, kach marchikin middilluav, umikkishshuav, uminnetiotav, uminniro shel chavero – chamishshim amma, kede shello yazzik. bishlama lerav ashe – nicha, ella leabbaye kashya! kashya.
Bishlama mimmikshoav umiddeloav – deazel avka veate belibbeh, umetzavve leh; ella minniro – ammay? amar rabbi abba bar zavda, veittema rabbi abba bar zutera: mippene

a: Sheose oto galal.

Mishna marchikin et hannevelot veet hakkevarot veet habbureski min hair – chamishshim amma. en osin bureski ella lemizrach hair. rabbi akiva omer: lechol ruach hu ose, chutz mimmaaravah; umarchik chamishshim amma. umerchikin et hammishra min hayyarak, veet hakkereshin min habbetzalim, veet hachardal min haddevorim. verabbi yose mattir bechardal.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: rabbi akiva hechi kaamar? lechol ruach hu ose vesomech, chutz mimmaaravah – demarchik chamishshim amma veose; o dilma: lechol ruach hu ose umarchik chamishshim amma, chutz mimmaaravah – deeno ose kelal?
Ta shema: detanya, rabbi akiva omer: lechol ruach hu ose umarchik chamishshim amma, chutz mimmaaravah deeno ose kol ikkar, mippene shehi tedira.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: may tedira? illema tedira beruchot, veha amar rav chanan bar abba amar rav: arba ruchot menashshevot bechol yom, veruach tzefonit im kullan; sheilmale ken – en haolam mitkayyem afillu shaa achat. veruach deromit kasha mikkullan, veilmale ben netz shemmaamidah – machrevet et haolam, shenneemar: "hamibbinatcha yaaver netz, yifros kenafav leteman"!
Ella may tedira – tedira bishchina. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: bou venachazik tova laavotenu, shehodiu mekom tefilla – dichtiv: "utzeva hashshamayim lecha mishtachavim".
Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: vedilma keeved shennotel peras merabbo, vechozer laachorav umishtachave! kashya.

Verabbi oshaya savar: shechina bechol makom. deamar rabbi oshaya, may dichtiv: "atta hu Adonai levaddecha, atta asita et hashshamayim vegomer"? sheluchecha lo kishluche basar vadam; sheluche basar vadam, mimmakom shemmishtallechim – lesham machazirim shelichutan; aval sheluchecha, lemakom shemmishtallechin – mishsham machzirin shelichutan, shenneemar: "hateshallach berakim veyelechu veyomru lecha hinnenu" – "yavou veyomru" lo neemar, ella "veyelechu veyomru", melammed shehashshechina bechol makom.

Veaf rabbi yishmael savar shechina bechol makom. detana deve rabbi yishmael: minnayin sheshshechina bechol makom? shenneemar: "hinne hammalach haddover bi yotze, umalach acher yotze likrato" – "acharav" lo neemar, ella "likrato", melammed sheshshechina bechol makom.
Veaf rav sheshet savar shechina bechol makom. daamar leh rav sheshet leshammaeh: lechol ruchata okman, levar mimmizrach. velav mishshum delet beh shechina, ella mishshum demoru be mine.
Verabbi avahu amar: shechina bammaarav – deamar rabbi avahu: may "orya"? avir yah.
Amar rav yehuda, may dichtiv "yaarof kammatar likchi"? zo ruach maaravit, shebbaa meorpo shel olam.
"Tizzal kattal imrati" – zo ruach tzefonit, shemmazzelet et hazzahav. vechen hu omer: "hazzalim zahav mikkis".
"Kisirim ale deshe" – zo ruach mizrachit, shemmaseret et kol haolam kesair. "vechirvivim ale esev" – zo ruach deromit, shehi maala revivim umegaddelet asavim.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: olam
b: Leachsadra hu dome, veruach tzefonit enah mesubbevet, vechevan shehiggia chamma etzel keren maaravit tzefonit – nichpefet veole lemala min harakia. verabbi yehoshua omer: olam lekubba hu dome, veruach tzefonit mesubbevet, vechevan shechamma maggaat lekeren maaravit tzefonit – makkefet vechozeret achore chippa;

Shenneemar: "holech el darom, vesovev el tzafon vegomer"; "holech el darom" – bayyom. "vesovev el tzafon" – ballayla. "sovev sovev holech haruach veal sevivotav shav haruach" – ellu pene mizrach ufene maarav, sheppeamim mesabbavtan ufeamim mehallachtan.

Hu haya omer – atan lerabbi eliezer: "min hacheder tavo sufa" – zo ruach deromit. "umimmezarim kara" – zo ruach tzefonit. "minnishmat el yitten karach" – zo ruach maaravit. "verochav mayim bemutzak" – zo ruach mizrachit.
Vehaamar mar: ruach deromit maala revivim umegaddelet asavim! la kashya; ha deatya mitra benichuta, ha bishfichuta.
Amar rav chisda, may dichtiv: "mitztzafon zahav yeete"? zo ruach tzefonit shemmazzelet et hazzahav. vechen hu omer: "hazzalim zahav mikkis".

Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash lo hugeshma ruach deromit, shenneemar: "vayyigzor al yamin veraev, vayyochal al semol velo saveu", uchetiv: "tzafon veyamin atta veratam".

Veamar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en haggeshamim yordin meotzar tov, shenneemar: "yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov" – bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom, veyisrael sheruyin al admatam – geshamim yordin meotzar tov; bizman sheen yisrael sheruyin al admatam – en geshamim yordin meotzar tov.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: harotze sheyyachkim – yadrim, vesheyyaashir – yatzpin, vesimanaych: shulchan batztzafon umenora baddarom. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: leolam yadrim, shemmittoch shemmitchakkem mitashsher – shenneemar: orech yamim biminah, bismolah osher vechavod".

Veha rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: shechina bammaarav! dematzded atzdode. amar leh rabbi chanina lerav ashe: kegon attun, deyatvitu bitzfonah deeretz yisrael – adrimu adrome. umena lan devavel litzfonah deeretz yisrael kayyma? dichtiv: "mitztzafon tippatach haraa al kol yoshve haaretz".

Marchikin et hammishra min hayyarak vechulei. tana: rabbi yose mattir bachardal, sheyyachol lomar lo: ad sheatta omer li harechek chardalecha min devorayy; harechek devorecha min chardalayy, shebbaot veochlot ligluge chardalayy.

Mishna marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma, uvecharuv uvashshikma – chamishshim amma; ben millemala ben min hatztzad. im habbor kadma – kotzetz venoten damim, veim ilan kadam – lo yakotz. safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam – lo yakotz. rabbi yose omer: af al pi shehabbor kodemet lailan – lo yakotz, shezze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello.

Gemara tana: ben shehabbor lematta veilan lemala, ben shehabbor lemala veilan lematta. bishlama bor lematta veilan lemala – ka azlin shorashin mazzeki la levor. ella bor lemala veilan lematta, ammay? amar rabbi chagga beshem rabbi yose: mippene shemmachlidin et hakkarka umalkin karkaitah shel bor.

Rabbi yose omer: af al pi shehabbor kodemet leilan – lo yakotz, shezze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. amar rav ashe: ki havan be rav kahana hava amrinan: mode rabbi yose begire dideh.

Pappi yonaa ani veheeshir hava. bena appadna. havo hanach atzore beshivavuteh, dechi havo dayyki shumeshme hava nayyda appadneh. ata lekammeh derav ashe, amar leh: ki havan be rav kahana hava amrinan: mode rabbi yose begire dileh.
Vechamma?

a: Kidnayed nichtema appummeh dechatzba.

Deve bar mariyyon bereh deravin, ki hava naftzi kittana – hava azla rakta umazzeka inashe. ato lekammeh deravina, amar lehu: ki amrinan mode rabbi yose begire dileh – hane mille deka azla mikkocho, hacha – zika hu deka mamte la.
Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: may shena mizzore veruach mesayyayto? amruha kammeh demarimar, amar lehu: hayeynu zore veruach mesayyayto.
Uleravina, may shena miggetz hayyotze mittachat happattish vehizzik – dechayyayv leshallem? hatam nicha leh delezil, hacha la nicha leh delezil.

Mishna lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot – echad gefanim veechad kol ilan. haya gader benatayim – ze somech laggader mikkan, veze somech laggader mikkan.
Hayu shorashim yotzim letoch shel chavero – maamik shelosha tefachim, kede shello yeakkev et hammacharesha. haya chofer bor, shiach umeara – kotzetz veyored, vehaetzim shello.

Gemara tana: arba ammot sheamru – kede avodat hakkerem. amar shemuel: lo shanu ella beeretz yisrael, aval bevavel – shete ammot. tanya name hachi: lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu shete ammot. veha anan tenan: arba ammot! ella lav kedishmuel? shema minna.
Veikka derame la mirme – tenan: lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot. vehatanya: shete ammot! amar shemuel: la kashya; kan bevavel, kan beeretz yisrael.

Rava bar rav chanan havo leh hanhu dikle, ammitzra defardesa derav yosef. havo atu tzippore yatvi bedikle, venachati befardesa umafsedi leh. amar leh: zil kotz. amar leh: veha archeki li! amar leh: hane mille leilanot, aval ligfanim bainan tefe.
Veha anan tenan: echad gefanim veechad kol ilan! amar leh: hane mille ilan leilan ugefanim ligfanim, aval ilan ligfanim bainan tefe.
Amar leh: ana la kayetzna, deamar rav: hay dikla detaen kabba – asur lemiktzeyeh. veamar rabbi chanina: la shechev shichchat beri, ella dekatz teenta bela zimneh. mar – i nicha leh, likkotz.

Rav pappa havo leh hanhu dikle ammitzra derav huna bereh derav yehoshua. azal ashkecheh dahava chafar, veka kaetz shorashav. amar leh: may hay? amar leh, tenan: hayu shorashim yotzim letoch shel chavero – maamik shelosha, kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha.

Amar leh: hane mille shelosha, mar ka chafar tefe! amar leh: ana borot shichin umearot ka chafarna – ditnan: haya chofer bor, shiach umeara – kotzetz veyored, vehaetzim shello. amar rav pappa: amari leh kullehi, vela yecheli leh;
b: Ad daamari leh ha deamar rav yehuda: metzer shehecheziku bo rabbim – asur lekalkelo. levatar dinfak, amar: ammay la amari leh: kan betoch shesh esre amma, kan chutz leshesh esre amma.
Haya chofer bor, shiach umeara – kotzetz veyored vehaetzim shello (vechulei). bea minneh yaakov hadeyayva merav chisda: etzim shel mi?
Amar leh, tenetuha: shorshe ilan shel hedyot habbain beshel hekdesh, lo nehenin velo moalin.
I amrat bishlama: batar ilan azlinan – mishshum hachi lo moalin; ella i amrat: batar karka azlinan, ammay lo moalin?
Ella may? batar ilan azlinan?! ema sefa: shel hekdesh habbaim beshel hedyot, lo nehenin velo moalin. vei batar ilan azlinan, ammay lo moalin?
Midde irya?! begiddulin habbain leachar mikkan askinan, veka savar: en meila begiddulin.
Ravina amar: la kashya; kan betoch shesh esre amma, kan chutz leshesh esre amma.
Amar ulla: ilan hassamuch lammetzer – betoch shesh esre amma, gazlan hu – veen meviin mimmennu bikkurim.
Mena leh leulla ha? illema midditnan: eser netiot hamefuzzarot betoch bet sea, chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan, ad rosh hashshana.
Kamma havu lehu – tere alfin vachamesh mea garmide; lechol chad vechad kamma mate leh – matan vechamshin; ha la have deulla!
Veella midditnan: shelosha ilanot shel shelosha bene adam – hare ellu mitztarfin, vechorshin kol
